# OCADE — master completion checklist (reconciled 27 Nov 2026)

**Source of truth for status:** [docs/REQUIREMENTS_LEDGER.md](REQUIREMENTS_LEDGER.md), generated by `scripts/requirements-ledger.py` from the repository and a per-file test run (`scripts/test-evidence.py`). **Requirements text:** [plan.md](../plan.md). **Security companion:** [OCADE_MASTER_SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md](OCADE_MASTER_SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md).

> **Rule.** A box is checked only when independently verified on the audited checkout. Nothing in sections 0 and 6–17 below has been verified as a whole, so they stay unchecked; the per-unit results live in the ledger. Sections that only restated plan sections, the 120 owner requirements, the 266 IDs, the 84 concepts and the 72 repository entries (805 boxes in sections 1–5; section 9's 38 boxes became one) were removed because each unit is now counted once in the ledger; every unit, its text and its source remain in plan.md and in the ledger, and the old boxes are in Git history (commit before the reconciliation). Sections 6–8 keep their clause-level acceptance boxes because those clauses are finer than the ledger units and are not tracked elsewhere. Coding completion and release readiness are reported separately in PROGRESS.md.

## 0. Checkpoint, traceability, re-audit and mandatory ordering

- [ ] Sync newest development-branch HEAD, safely preserve concurrent/local-only changes, inspect actual code, tests, migrations, app screens, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` and every governing plan section.
- [ ] Make a persistent per-ID ledger: exact source, current code owner and caller, real tests, platform, SHA, missing behavior, blocker, authorized decision, priority and reproducible proof.
- [ ] Distinguish CODED/PARTIAL/MISSING/BROKEN/LOCAL-TESTED/CI-GREEN/RUNTIME-VERIFIED/BLOCKED/INAPPLICABLE; prior status is evidence to check, not a PASS by inheritance.
- [ ] Finish all mandatory coding, every discovered defective/partial integration and all applicable Parts 27/28; continue until entire plan has zero known missing mandatory coding and the independent code audit is complete.
- [ ] Apply/verify UX-01..UX-34 on every relevant website/companion screen with meaningful responsive/accessibility and user-journey proofs, not simply a document claiming each name.
- [ ] Re-read the ENTIRE `plan.md`, archived requirements and the complete security register after coding; add any omitted requirements before advancing.
- [ ] Security Stage 2: remediate/independently test every applicable risk and negative case, with no known unresolved high/critical safety defect before benchmarking.
- [ ] Debloat Stage 3 only after security closure: remove proven dead modules, duplicates and obsolete dependencies with before/after measurements; preserve data, STOP, security and essential tests.
- [ ] Stage 4: all mandatory GitHub workflows including website/backend/Windows/macOS/native companion/DB/security COMPLETE GREEN on exact same frozen candidate SHA, not merely prior green runs.
- [ ] Stage 5: after owner-authorized staging schema, measure real models and solo/team planners, speed, cost, first-attempt accuracy and independently verified output; obey quota/budget.
- [ ] Stage 6: only after preceding gates, first pass 4 tasks × 2 models × Windows/macOS = 16 hosted real-app comparisons, then E1–E4 and all routes/customer workflows; offline disconnection LAST.
- [ ] On every failure preserve traces, make smallest general fix, add regression, redo security/debloat and all-green CI on fresh SHA, then rerun with same independent oracle. Never alter expected answers or pass thresholds.
- [ ] No main merge, public deployment, spending, consumer-PC access, protected staging write, external financial operation, certificate/payment activation or secrets change without specific approval.
- [ ] Separate coding-completion % from formal release-readiness gates; 'zero bugs' means no known unresolved applicable release blockers under defined verified tests, not an impossible guarantee.
- [ ] Final independent source/code/test/UX/security/runtime review with exact links, blocked-items list and truthful GO/NO-GO; real launch requires separate owner approval.

### 14B online/offline Chat, BYOK, web/settings/policies

- [ ] 1. **Model-agnostic backend.** Expose a provider-neutral planning/chat API, unified capability contract and streaming state, while preserving distinct chat and JARVIS permissions. Support model families beyond Gemini/Gemma through approved provider adapters; choose by actual vision, tool schema, latency, context, safety and cost rather than hardcoded brand identifiers. The initial 16-run comparison remains Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite versus Gemma 4 31B and does not authorize live use of untested models. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1313)
- [ ] 2. **Supabase key registry.** Register any number of already-authorized key slots against real provider/project/account/model identities, encrypted server-side. Selection uses health, remaining lawful quota, task permission, data-region eligibility, configured priority and service cost. Health rotation handles revoked or failing keys; not quota evasion. Multiple keys in the same project share project-level quota where provider rules say so. Never copy keys from chat, screenshots or test output. Separate staging and production. Require owner-approved secret access and do not assume Supabase/CI secrets have been checked. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1314)
- [ ] 3. **Online chat functionality.** Code complete chat initiation, new/edit/regenerate conversation, streaming answer, STOP, history persistence, clear error states, optional attachments, safe file previews, token/status usage, model selector, clipboard copy, exports where supported, context and model availability, rate-limit handling, protected deletion and per-account isolation. Use the same design primitives, not the JARVIS command authority. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1315)
- [ ] 4. **Model qualification before release.** Each provider adapter needs positive/negative tests for schema, streaming, long context, images, tool calls, refusals, unknown unsupported parameters, timeouts, retries, rate limiting, pricing/quota reporting, data isolation and approved region use. No hardcoded provider keys in browser bundles or mocks promoted to runtime results. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1316)

Agent swarms cannot perform duplicate desktop actions or replace faster deterministic operations. Report actual number of model calls, latency and failure rate. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1317)

Remove the three-fixed-Gemini-slot architectural ceiling. Support at least 100 simulated key records with no additional source edits or redeploys. There is no claim of infinite request capacity or free provider quotas. Store each secret using Supabase Vault or a vetted equivalent encrypted secret manager; store only opaque secret references and nonsecret metadata in protected server-owned tables. Never retain plaintext in localStorage, IndexedDB, sessionStorage, URL parameters, browser state beyond entry, logs, observability, prompts, task journals, screenshots, exports or client-readable database rows. Never return the raw key in an API response. Show alias, provider, model and a masked nonsecret fingerprint instead. Server-side account ownership is checked for every listing, test, routing, use, update and delete. Preserve only the required nonsecret audit receipt. Deleting a user removes its associated Vault references and secrets after proper authorization. - [ ] 6. **Validated gateway and SSRF protection.** Only trusted server code, never browser code or the customer companion, makes key-bearing model calls. Enforce HTTPS and validated host, certificate, port and IP. Deny loopback/private/link-local/reserved IPv4 or IPv6, internal DNS and cloud metadata endpoints; block or revalidate every redirect; protect against DNS rebinding and IPv4-in-IPv6 encodings. Bound response bytes, stream lifetime, redirects, schemas and retry budgets. Do not let a custom URL relay privileged headers, cloud secrets or customer data to an unauthorized endpoint. Validate provider protocol compatibility, not just a successful HTTP 200. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1333)

Fallback between model/provider/credential pools is off by default and requires explicit informed opt-in, compliant data region and provider, customer permissions and a known-safe continuation state. ### 14C elite optimization and product upgrades

- [ ] - **ELITE-01 | P0 | Verified Outcome Contracts.** Capture approved artifact/output schema, exact preconditions, irreversible effects and independent acceptance oracle before executing; reject completion without receipt. **Acceptance:** Wrong totals or missing files cannot settle as completed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1527)
- [ ] - **ELITE-02 | P0 | Deterministic Workflow Compiler.** Compile repeated verified recipes into parameterized native/file/DOM execution with postcondition guards, semantic version checks and STOP fencing. **Acceptance:** Held-out repeated workflows use fewer model calls without reducing verified success. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1528)
- [ ] - **ELITE-03 | P0 | Cost-Aware Model Router.** Choose authorized qualified model by observed cost per verified task, latency, capability and risk, honoring immutable BYOK/OCADE source. **Acceptance:** No cross-source inference call and lower cost at equal success on matched tasks. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1529)
- [ ] - **ELITE-04 | P1 | Customer ProofPack.** Return editable deliverable with redacted source/changed-file hashes, discrepancies, verified checks, time and unresolved exceptions. **Acceptance:** Proof summary agrees with independent verifier and contains no secrets. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1530)
- [ ] - **ELITE-05 | P1 | Certified Workflow Library.** Version, test, expire and revert successful customer-authorized workflows; preserve user edits and do not memorize raw selectors/secrets. **Acceptance:** Cross-file regression and changed-app tests prevent harmful replay. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1531)
- [ ] - **ELITE-06 | P1 | Business Workspaces and Approvals.** Use existing organization/permission schema for client isolation, maker/checker approval, scoped sharing and activity. **Acceptance:** Unauthorized worker cannot read or approve another client's result. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1532)
- [ ] - **ELITE-07 | P0 | Continuous Fault and Recovery Testing.** Inject crashed agent, interrupted write, network outage, stale UI target and quota exhaustion with documented recovery fixtures. **Acceptance:** Unknown effect never repeats automatically and STOP always fences new actions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1533)
- [ ] - **ELITE-08 | P0 | Contribution-Margin Optimizer.** Measure full cost per verified result including model, provider, infrastructure, retry, support, verification, refunds and revenue. **Acceptance:** Shared budgets and per-workflow margin remain truthful when tasks fail. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1534)
- [ ] - **MOAT-01 | P0 | Accountant Reconciliation Beachhead.** Target one tested spreadsheet reconciliation, exception list and editable client report before launching broad feature catalog. **Acceptance:** Five consenting design partners demonstrate repeat use and correctness. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1538)
- [ ] - **MOAT-02 | P1 | Vertical Outcome Packs.** Sell narrowly specified verified workflows and supported formats to accountants and service firms. **Acceptance:** Each pack documents scope, acceptance, errors, version and limitations. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1539)
- [ ] - **MOAT-03 | P1 | Evidence-Led Marketing.** Publish only reproducible redacted before/after demonstrations and permissioned customer examples. **Acceptance:** Marketing claims match real tested outcomes and selected comparison conditions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1540)
- [ ] - **MOAT-04 | P1 | BYOK-Compatible Paid Value.** Charge for orchestration, deliverables, approvals, support and templates independently of which provider funds tokens. **Acceptance:** BYOK external charge and OCADE product charge shown separately; positive margin measured. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1541)
- [ ] - **MOAT-05 | P1 | Permissioned Recurring Work.** Allow schedule only with fresh bounded permission, one occurrence claim and explicit revocation. **Acceptance:** Duplicate triggers cannot cause two business-side mutations. - [ ] - **MOAT-08 | P2 | Accountant and Agency Distribution.** Pilot consent-based referrals and team/agency workflows before paid growth channels. **Acceptance:** Measure paid activation, retention, acquisition cost and account isolation. - [ ] - **OWNER-01 | P0 | Universal Model Gateway.** Register protocol adapters, compatible endpoints and approved models without changing the central JARVIS planner. **Acceptance:** A newly authorized provider passes contract tests with no central-code rewrite. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1549)
- [ ] - **OWNER-02 | P0 | 100+ Dynamic API Keys.** Replace three static Gemini slots with secure Supabase owner registry and tenant-scoped BYOK refs. **Acceptance:** At least 100 fake keys concurrently stored/selected/revoked with no redeployment. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1550)
- [ ] - **OWNER-03 | P0 | Intelligent Limit Detection.** Classify 401/403/402/429/5xx, project quota vs model rate, reset and billing separately. **Acceptance:** Correct provider-specific wait, replacement or refusal with no fabricated quota. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1551)
- [ ] - **OWNER-04 | P0 | Model Capability Registry.** Record tool calls, schema, vision, reasoning, streaming, context, cost and residency per adapter/model. **Acceptance:** Unsupported model cannot silently run a restricted JARVIS tool. ### 14D advanced multi-agent/model work

- [ ] 1. **One project truth:** A durable, versioned and authenticated project contract records objective, customer constraints, approvals, output acceptance, team/role assignments, artifact manifest, dependency graph, reference frames and units where applicable, funding source, budget, current decisions, task status, input hashes, output hashes and STOP epoch. Each worker sees the current authorized revision, relevant immutable inputs and exactly what it owns; no worker silently redefines the goal. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1621)
- [ ] 2. **Parallel independent production; exclusive conflicting writes:** Agents concurrently create or transform different approved portions, using isolated workspaces, files or applications. A resource-scoped exclusive lease protects every shared document, file path, app session, window, external account or integration commit where changes could conflict. Read-only work can parallelize when safe. One PC input controller per overlapping session remains authoritative, including for the coordinator. Unowned changes are denied. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1622)
- [ ] 3. **Dependency-aware live synchronization:** Every work package has explicit prerequisites, output schema, acceptance rules and input versions. When an accepted upstream decision/artifact changes, only dependent items are marked stale, notified and reworked. Unaffected work continues. The coordinator cannot accept an old result against a new project revision. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1623)
- [ ] 4. **Structured collaboration, not endless agent conversation:** Typed event/ACK messages deliver TASK_ASSIGNED, TASK_READY, REVISION_CHANGED, ARTIFACT_PROPOSED, ARTIFACT_ACCEPTED, DEPENDENCY_INVALIDATED, CONFLICT, REWORK_REQUESTED, TOOL_DENIED, STOP and RESUME with project/tenant IDs, source revision, event ID, sequence, sender and receiver. Messages are authenticated, deduplicated, permission-limited, bounded and never authority grants. Agents exchange hashes, diffs and specific decisions rather than entire repeated histories. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1624)
- [ ] 5. **Truthful success and controlled corrections:** Agent self-reports do not certify correctness; accepted intermediate and final artifacts require independent oracles/receipts suited to the output. A director may diagnose and correct only after acquiring the current ownership grant. Unknown effects remain quarantined; STOP, Take Over, human revisions and irreversible-action approvals prevail. Do not promise perfection or no mistakes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1625)

- [ ] 1. **Count:** Support a configurable number of logical agents; the initial **5–8 productive active-agent target** is an operational recommendation, NOT a technical ceiling, guaranteed simultaneous LLM concurrency or minimum for every task. Admit 1, 2, 5, 8 or more only as justified by parallelizable tasks, skill compatibility, actual user need, provider RPM/TPM, memory/CPU/GPU and budget. Automatically deallocate idle agents; refuse agent inflation when it increases cost or error rate. Maintain simple one-agent/deterministic path as a serious competing baseline. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1687)
- [ ] 2. **Coordinator:** Owns decomposition, overall standards, integration schedule, dependency tracking, dynamic conflict resolution and quality review; also performs useful corrective work under a valid resource lease. It cannot override user constraints or be both sole approver and independent verifier of its own consequential changes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1688)
- [ ] 3. **Workers:** Each specialist has a concrete output to create/edit, not a title alone. Output ownership may be per file, document portion, asset version, independent computation or isolated app session; never assume specialties are limited to a named use case. Workers publish staged artifacts and evidence before integration. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1689)
- [ ] 4. **Conflict prevention:** At scheduling time reject overlapping resource write sets; enforce distributed leases with fencing epochs at execution time, compare-and-swap expected input revisions at integration time, and stop/unblock/replan when user edits intervene. An expired agent cannot continue writing even if it returns later. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1690)
- [ ] 5. **Model versus computer concurrency:** One key can serve many logical agents but all share its real provider-account/project quota; a provider gate serializes or parallelizes model calls within actual token/request/concurrency budgets. Work that does not need a model continues through deterministic operations and durable device jobs. A separate API key never automatically means independent quota. One customer desktop session is not a multi-cursor desktop **at the OS input level**; the owner nonetheless REQUIRES many genuinely concurrent independently executing agents, each with its own truthful colored virtual pointer/activity overlay where appropriate. Native API, headless, browser-context and isolated-process concurrency MUST NOT be artificially serialized behind a single global mouse mutex. See Part 14F. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1691)
- [ ] 6. **Live correction loop:** Detect mismatched artifacts, version drift or acceptance failures early; assign smallest impacted correction, notify dependencies, reverify changed components and the aggregate output, and preserve unrelated productive progress. Bounded recovery and human escalation protect against recursive churn, repeated mistakes and excessive spend. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1692)
- [ ] 7. **84-concept integration:** Reuse all applicable existing OCADE concepts as system capabilities, NOT 84 agents or 84 AI requests. Map concepts 1–23 to task/context/tool selection, 24–49 to platform/operations, 50–70 to locking/cancellation/grants/security, 71–84 to deliverable evidence and performance qualification. Keep the authoritative concept-by-concept definitions and statuses in Appendix B, with a one-to-one implementation/proof crosswalk and no extra implementation solely to increase concept usage. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1693)

[Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1732)

### 14E memory, dynamic composer, files and auth

- [ ] 1. **Useful personal context, not unlimited surveillance.** OCADE should understand an authenticated customer through their authorized chats, accepted project results, consented preferences and optionally connected data. It must not claim literally complete knowledge of a person, automatically scan private files/screens/accounts, or silently create a sensitive profile. Optional long-term memory defaults and scope must be explained and user-controllable. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1740)
- [ ] 2. **Ownership invariant:** User A's chat, profile, memories, summaries, inferred preferences, embeddings, vector hits, search indices, uploaded files, source citations, screenshots, task and agent context, cached results, API keys, connected accounts, projects, browser tabs, telemetry and derived training-like records MUST NEVER be retrieved for, injected into a prompt for, exposed to, or influence recommendations to User B. Identical names, provider models, accounts at the same vendor, devices, groups or shared API-key projects do not permit leakage. Owner/staff access is not a privacy bypass. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1741)
- [ ] 3. **Scopes and namespaces:** Distinguish temporary turn context, private conversation memory, private project/task memory, optional user-profile long-term memory, and separately permissioned organization-shared data. Only an explicitly granted shared-project resource enters shared context; personal profile memory never becomes organization memory by default. Preserve provenance, consent/source type, creation/update time, sensitivity class, confidence, expiration, owner and effective access scope for every record. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1742)
- [ ] 4. **Backend security BEFORE retrieval:** Derive tenant_id and user_id from validated active session, NEVER from URL/body, model text, external connector username, customer-editable metadata or @ token. Apply RLS plus grants/RPC/Edge Function checks at storage and on every retrieval; filter tenant/user namespace before vector or semantic similarity search, then reauthorize each hydrated source and source citation. Cache keys include tenant/user/project/permissions/revision; never share model context/session cache across users or reuse unrestricted memory summaries in background workers. Service-role callers enforce ownership manually, and inaccessible auth or grants fail closed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1743)
- [ ] 5. **Safe memory intelligence:** Separate a fact the user explicitly stated, an inferred preference and an unverified guess. User corrections and current instructions supersede stale memories, subject to authorization. Retrieved text is untrusted DATA, not a policy, tool command or permission. Agents and prompt enhancement receive only the smallest relevant authorized subset. Never store passwords, cookies, private tokens, OTP, unnecessary sensitive data or raw screen recordings as memory. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1744)

Clarify disabling future learning versus turning off retrieval versus permanent deletion, including honest limits of backup retention. Respect account closure, consent withdrawal, device/connector revocation and organization exit. No silent model training or external provider export of private profiles without user consent. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1745)

- [ ] 1. **Placement:** One small distinctive sparkle icon located at the BOTTOM LEFT of the existing composer, integrated with existing attachment/voice/send controls without replacing them. - [ ] 2. **Function:** On an explicit click, take the user's raw text and propose a cleanly structured, clearer and more actionable version while preserving the EXACT intent, language preference, constraints, negations, quoted text, dates, numbers, units, file paths, URLs, @ resource chips and stable IDs, desired output, cost limits, safety instructions and task boundaries. Improve order, clarity, scope and meaningful acceptance criteria only when genuinely supported; do not invent personal facts, files, app state, permissions or goals. Memory personalization is optional and uses only that user's authenticated, relevant and consented chat/project/profile context. Reduced-motion preference changes the morph to a static or subtle fade and never blocks action. Low-power devices and mobile keyboard/safe-area layout receive separate tests. Do not use distracting constant shimmer. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1753)

Test difficult multilingual, ambiguous, long, rich Markdown, prompt-injection, memory conflicts, concurrent typing and user account switching. - [ ] 2. **Scoped Context Graph:** Link only consented user-level facts, accepted project decisions, resource references and verified work in the existing storage; preserve provenance and expiry, not a second global vector memory engine. Existing security and task-authority owners must prove denials at API, RLS, RPC, agent and local companion layers. Use OWASP Agent Security https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/AI_Agent_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html and current MCP authorization https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/index.mdx for developer research, not as a substitute for … read full source [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1830)

Neither Chat nor JARVIS may claim an unavailable provider, unsupported browser, model, integration, memory protection or no-error guarantee as implemented. User testing must check trust and comprehension, not merely visuals. The final exact 30-law UI checklist is intentionally placed at the END of the pre-benchmark plan, immediately before Appendix H. ### 14F parallel agents, floating bar, native live vision

- [ ] 1. **REAL parallel work:** Multiple admitted subagents each own a genuine concurrently executable workstream with independent task identity, capabilities, process/worker context where applicable, input versions, output ownership, progress events, verification and cancel state. An agent's activity must correspond to actual dispatched/observed work. Several colored pointers driven by ONE serial automation worker are NOT an acceptable implementation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1847)
- [ ] 2. **ONE customer project:** The subagents collaborate toward one authorized goal, publish independent artifacts and dependencies, and integrate only through versioned, verified state. A coordinator may itself work on an independently leased item. The number of active agents is determined by useful ready work and resource constraints, not a decorative swarm count. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1848)
- [ ] 3. **Actual computer, actual installed tools:** Prefer the user's own Windows/macOS machine and genuinely installed applications, supported plug-ins, scripts, presets, licenses, files and profiles. No mandatory VM, Docker, cloud desktop, duplicated user desktop or remote app installation for the normal customer experience. Isolated local subprocesses and separate application sessions are allowed when supported and licensed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1849)
- [ ] 4. **Non-interference first:** The user may keep watching video, gaming, typing or working in unrelated applications. Background execution must not steal foreground focus, move the system mouse, type into the user's active window, hijack global shortcuts or require a desktop takeover. If an operation cannot be completed safely without foreground interaction, queue it, ask for an explicit Live handoff, or mark it blocked; never silently violate this invariant. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1850)
- [ ] 5. **Many colored cursor identities, not many invented OS pointers:** Each agent has a stable distinct colored virtual cursor/activity identity and visible evidence-backed progress. The overlay represents that agent's actual app target or operation. Do not claim standard Windows/macOS provides many independent system mouse cursors clicking the SAME ordinary desktop simultaneously. True simultaneous execution is through separate native APIs, app contexts, file operations, scripts, processes or genuinely independent interactive sessions; shared OS pointer input must be arbitrated. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1851)
- [ ] 6. **Compact, app-specific overlay:** The owner wants a screenshot-sized floating agent bar over the TARGET APP ONLY by default, not a permanent global dashboard. It shows truthful active-agent count, current work, live progress, Stop, Pin and expandable role/activity details. Its instruction composer is ALWAYS OUTSIDE the dropdown and stays usable when that dropdown is closed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1852)
- [ ] 7. **Continuous instruction changes:** The user can inspect, edit instructions, redirect a named agent or the team, pause, stop and safely resume without abandoning unaffected independent work. Changes must be versioned, permission checked and propagated to affected workers. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1853)
- [ ] 8. **Speed with correctness:** Prefer direct edits, application commands, efficient text insertion, batched tool calls, concurrency and event-driven verification. Do not waste time simulating character-by-character typing or animating pointer motion as a substitute for work. No universal 11.6-second, 38-agent, zero-resource-cost or any-complex-task speed promise. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1854)
- [ ] 9. **Visible, revocable authority:** A local STOP must work without model/network availability; Pin never extends permission; the overlay cannot conceal destructive actions, fabricate progress or intercept user input unintentionally. All 30+4 UX laws apply at the highest practically beneficial level. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1855)
- [ ] 1. Extend the existing signed companion, device gateway, typed capability catalog, Supabase task authority, journal, model budget/router, verifier and worker pool. The product name for the capability may be **OCADE Foreground-Safe Parallel Execution Engine**, but do NOT create a second task engine, competing planner, second permission store, app-by-app one-off agent framework, duplicated local memory or mandatory cloud desktop. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1859)
- [ ] 2. **Background mode (default for nonintrusive work):** Execute permitted native application APIs, file operations, headless/batch tasks, CLI, background scripting, non-focus-stealing accessibility patterns and isolated browser contexts while the human controls their own desktop. Observe the target app when possible. If a UI-only action would take over the real keyboard/mouse, suspend that step and continue independent work. Keep the compact bar attached to the target window; a user can Pin the bar globally without globally exposing the target's cursor overlays. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1860)
- [ ] 3. **Live mode (explicit handoff):** When a foreground-only app/UI action is essential, clearly identify target app, exact control scope and expected interruption; the user explicitly yields control. Use the single physical pointer/keyboard stream only while the current signed lease allows it; Take Over/Stop immediately fences further actions. Switching back to Background does not make GUI-only actions magically invisible. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1861)
- [ ] 4. Both modes share the SAME task graph, source-of-truth project revisions, permission grants, checkpoints, visual observations, agent IDs, usage ledger and independent verification. Switching mode never resets a project, grants extra access, duplicates irreversible effects or loses accepted work. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1862)
- [ ] 5. **Capability negotiation:** For each application and installed version, discover: native API/script/headless availability, plugin compatibility, GUI-only dependencies, current app instance and license session, supported concurrent documents/instances, accessibility support, capture support, hardware requirements and whether focus is needed. Declare UNKNOWN until tested; do not infer from the app name or from a single working version. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1863)
- [ ] 6. **Isolation is logical and resource-scoped, not mandatory VM isolation:** Use separate process/job handles, temp staging directories, file snapshots/worktrees where useful, app-document leases, plugin/app commands and named worker IDs. Every process launched by OCADE is tracked and reaped or explicitly detached under the existing safe-job contract. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1864)
- [ ] 1. **Independent work channels:** Each subagent owns a task-graph node or safe partition, structured context, capability allowlist, local process/app-session reference, resource lease set, tool-call budget, checkpoint and current observation revision. Its work proceeds concurrently with disjoint nodes. One worker waiting for model output, render completion, network or approval does not freeze other independent workers. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1868)
- [ ] 2. **Resource model:** Canonical resources include project revision, source file/hash, destination file, application process/instance, document, scene, timeline, browser context/tab, OS window, native plugin bridge, GPU-intensive job, external account and irreversible external transaction. Declare read/write sets before admission. Use read sharing where safe, exclusive writer leases with fencing generations for conflicts, optimistic expected-version checks, and transactional staging/promote. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1869)
- [ ] 3. **No global artificial serialization:** The coordinator controls authority and schedules conflicting effects; it is NOT a global execution mutex. Parallelize native script calls against independent instances/documents, file preprocessing, asset generation, API-backed edits, verification, tests and rendering within safe limits. Serialize only operations that share unsafe mutable state, OS input, a non-reentrant application API or a bounded hardware resource. - [ ] 4. **Application thread safety:** An app may expose one main UI/event loop or document state that cannot be mutated simultaneously. Agents can still prepare work concurrently, then enqueue validated main-thread operations through a single in-app dispatcher for THAT shared resource. Report queued versus actively executing honestly; do not count a waiting agent as concurrently clicking. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1871)
- [ ] 5. **Color and pointer semantics:** Assign an accessible, stable agent color plus name/shape/pattern (not color alone), keyed to immutable agent ID. Render one independent virtual pointer per active agent where an actual target position/region exists; pointer position comes from the agent's observed target/action metadata and capture geometry, never a random animation. For API/file/headless work without a meaningful pointer coordinate, show a colored agent indicator over the relevant app region/object or in the dropdown, not a fabricated mouse click. Permit user to hide all cursors while work continues. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1872)
- [ ] 6. **Real-time synchronization:** Source revision changes, lease acquisition/release, pending/started/verified effects, app events and verification are broadcast with bounded authenticated event queues. Duplicate, late and reordered messages cannot create effects. On a user edit, compare expected source version; preserve the human's edit, stop conflicting operations, invalidate only affected descendants and rebase/ask where needed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1873)
- [ ] 7. **Concurrency policy:** Dynamically admit useful agents by ready DAG nodes, capability, CPU/RAM/GPU/VRAM, disk, model/provider quotas, BYOK funding and user foreground workload. Scale down idle workers. Count **active executing**, **waiting**, **paused** and **blocked** separately; never use an inflated logical-agent count as a success metric. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1874)
- [ ] 8. **Conflict and recovery:** Keep immutable staged inputs/outputs, bounded rollback, exact hash receipts and per-agent last safe checkpoint. A crashed worker loses its lease by fencing epoch, not merely by elapsed time. Unknown side effects are quarantined for inspection; never blind-retry external submissions, saves or destructive edits. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1875)

Avoid overlaying exclusive-fullscreen games, interfering with anti-cheat, screen-recording secure surfaces or hijacking focus. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1901)
- [ ] 2. **App-native first:** Discover supported native API, command line, scripting host, file format, installed plugin/add-on bridge and document model. Reuse the user's existing licensed installation when supported. Do not assume add-ons requiring a viewport, login, hardware context or UI thread work in headless mode, and do not copy/rehost licensed plugins without authorization. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1902)
- [ ] 3. **Blender reference only (NOT a hardcoded product path):** For supported tasks use installed Blender Python/bpy, documented background rendering/CLI, object/scene state, addon capability checks, staged assets and optional in-process main-thread bridge. Concurrent agents can create textures, geometry source, assets, scripts and renders in independent processes; mutation of one shared open Blender scene must be marshaled safely through its supported main thread or isolated documents, not unrestricted concurrent bpy thread writes. A minimized/occluded viewport may not provide fresh visible frames; native state remains available if supported. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1903)
- [ ] 4. **Other creative apps as capability examples:** Premiere/Photoshop supported UXP/extension APIs where available; After Effects documented render automation; DaVinci Resolve supported scripting where licensed and exposed; media preparation via ffmpeg, OpenTimelineIO/FCPXML/AAF where compatible; CAD/DCC/document applications through their supported interfaces. Do not assert all versions expose all APIs, that external timeline formats preserve every feature, or that a GUI-only feature can run invisibly. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1904)
- [ ] 5. **Safe staged workflow:** Copy/derive input → execute on permitted workspace/instance → observe state → verify artifact/format/result → atomically promote or save with expected revision → report receipt. Preserve original user edits and external references. Require explicit permission for destructive changes or external publishing. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1905)
- [ ] 6. **Fallback policy:** If the only route is physical UI interaction and the user is actively using the PC, wait or request Live mode. A second monitor, hidden desktop, patched RDP, unapproved virtual display, mandatory VM, Docker, cloud machine or invisible click-through control is NOT a universal supported substitute. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1906)
- [ ] 7. **Resource governor:** Cap simultaneous heavy GPU jobs on constrained devices, prioritize foreground responsiveness, use app-supported low-priority background processes and OS-specific scheduling, avoid simultaneous redundant render loads, and let the user configure background resource limits. Show truthful estimated impact, current throttling and deferred work. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1907)
- [ ] 1. **Direct insertion instead of fake typing:** For supported editors/apps use authorized API insertion, batch document updates, native edit commands, clipboard paste with secure clipboard restore where appropriate, DOM fill, direct file writes and transactionally applied diffs. Preserve encoding, caret/selection, formatting, undo and focus. Do not type every character slowly merely to animate an agent. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1911)
- [ ] 2. **Batch deterministic operations:** Compile stable substeps into guarded native scripts, application commands or file transforms; validate inputs once per revision and verify outputs once per meaningful boundary. Avoid model calls per mouse movement, repeated unchanged screenshots, per-character keystrokes or full tool-schema resend. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1912)
- [ ] 3. **Parallel DAG scheduling:** Execute independent work concurrently, run I/O and compute asynchronously, use work-stealing only within lease/capability constraints, prefetch allowed metadata, reuse compiled verified skills and cache immutable observations. Never parallelize overlapping file writes, unbounded model calls or unsupported app mutations. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1913)
- [ ] 4. **Resource-aware model budget:** Share provider quota, concurrency and cost admission across all agents, including BYOK. Deduplicate equivalent subcalls, use small delta context, route trivial deterministic work without an LLM, and escalate only uncertain or visually complex steps to qualified models. No unauthorized model/source switch. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1914)
- [ ] 5. **Real speed reporting:** Separate model wait, observation/capture, perception inference, tool dispatch, app execution, render/export, lock wait, verification, UI event delivery and human approvals. Record wall time and sum of worker CPU time separately; N workers finishing in parallel does not imply N-fold speedup. Compare against a one-agent native-first baseline on identical seeded tasks and device conditions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1915)
- [ ] 6. **Video example boundary:** The owner's reference image displayed “38 agents” and “11.6s” for another UI. This is NOT a measured OCADE result, not proof of 38 independent desktop pointers, and not a universal task-speed target. Optimize for correct verified completion time, low foreground disruption and cost, not a swarm animation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1916)
- [ ] 1. **Windows:** Prefer Windows.Graphics.Capture / WinRT window capture (HWND/window item), Direct3D11 frame-arrival callbacks and GPU-side change/copy where practical. Avoid a full-display recorder and unnecessary CPU readback for every compositor frame. Respect OS capture consent, protected-content restrictions, resize/DPI, GPU resets, minimized/closed windows and target-identity renewal. Screenpipe's Windows Graphics Capture implementation is a concrete reference, not a drop-in license/compatibility guarantee. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1939)
- [ ] 2. **macOS:** Prefer ScreenCaptureKit SCStream with a target-window/application content filter and OS Screen Recording authorization; manage filter/window identity, Retina scale, stream lifecycle and permission revocation. The inspected CUA macOS backend shows ScreenCaptureKit VIDEO RECORDING, not a completed live AI perception loop; adapt native capture semantics without conflating them. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1940)
- [ ] 3. **Browser:** For the OCADE-owned authorized browser use CDP Page.startScreencast / Page.screencastFrame and frame acknowledgements, or browser-native video capture where supported; pair frames with DOM/navigation/accessibility events. OpenClaw and Nod show real browser streaming paths. Their preview streams do NOT establish that every frame is analyzed by an LLM. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1941)
- [ ] 4. **One capture per target app/window:** A shared authorized capture service fans out timestamped frames and structured events to multiple agent subscriptions and the user preview. Avoid N independent 30-FPS capture processes for N agents. Scope every frame to account, device, task, window, process generation, display geometry, capture permission and expiry. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1942)
- [ ] 5. **Separated preview vs AI rates:** Preview may target smooth 15–30 FPS on capable devices when visible and permitted, adapting lower for load/battery/network; AI analysis starts from events/keyframes at a substantially lower adaptive rate (e.g. 0.2–2 FPS, brief higher-rate bursts only when justified). These are INITIAL TUNING HYPOTHESES, not guaranteed rates or provider capability claims. Never send 30 FPS to an expensive model merely because preview renders at 30 FPS. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1943)
- [ ] 6. **Bounded memory/backpressure:** Maintain a latest-N ring buffer and timestamped keyframes, drop superseded frames, avoid unbounded JPEG/base64 copies, separate video encoder from model analysis, use bounded queues/ACKs and cancel stale inference on task revision changes. For agent-specific questions, crop the region of interest from the shared frame and preserve transform/scale metadata. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1944)
- [ ] 7. **Minimized/occluded/protected windows:** Distinguish visible fresh frame, last known frame, unavailable capture, native state still available and genuinely blocked. Do not claim to see a minimized Blender viewport if it stops rendering; continue native-state/headless work when supported, request Live handoff only for unavoidable GUI-only inspection. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1945)
- [ ] 8. **Permissions/privacy:** User grants only the target app/window and task scope. No incidental desktop-wide capture, microphone/camera, passwords, unrelated notifications or secret-bearing screenshots. Redact sensitive regions before model/preview, use ephemeral local buffers by default, and disclose any off-device frame/clip transfer, provider, retention and BYOK cost. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1946)
- [ ] 1. **Capture → events → filter → understand:** Ingest native app state changes, DOM mutations, accessibility notifications, window/process state, render job events and frame-arrival callbacks into a single timestamped event stream. Coalesce bursts and use a bounded idle/backstop refresh to detect missed events. Do not poll the model to wait for renders. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1950)
- [ ] 2. **Cheap filtering first:** Compare hashes, downsampled pixel differences, region-of-interest changes and known expected effects. Skip unchanged frames. Escalate unexpected motion, scene transitions, modal dialogs, missing controls or mismatched expected state to OCR, visual parser or multimodal reasoning. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1951)
- [ ] 3. **Temporal context:** For motion, provide short ordered keyframe sequences or a provider-supported live-video input with accurate timestamps and app-state annotations. Never assume all providers accept video, unlimited FPS, audio, or the same input pricing. Fallback to bounded frame batches if provider lacks true streaming video input. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1952)
- [ ] 4. **Shared state store:** Maintain ONE versioned, permission-scoped per-target observation snapshot: app/document revision, window/process identity, capture generation, native/DOM/AX facts, frame timestamps, relevant crops, visual uncertainty, pending tool effects and user edits. Each subagent subscribes to the smallest authorized portion; all use the same capture source and conflict-aware revision model. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1953)
- [ ] 5. **Agent-specific perception:** Effects agent may receive viewport/keyframe and effect stack; assets agent receives authorized asset list and file events; lighting agent receives scene state and selected viewport region. These are EXAMPLES of dynamically assigned work, never hardcoded roles. Independent agents may reason in parallel; their write authority remains resource-scoped. - [ ] 6. **Confidence and freshness:** Track provenance for every observation (native/DOM/AX/frame/OCR/model), capturedAt, observedAt, target/window ID, geometry, revision, confidence and expiry. A visual suggestion is NOT a trusted action target until the local worker revalidates current identity/geometry and relevant preconditions. Unexpected overlay, popup, focus change, user input or navigation invalidates stale coordinate grounding. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1955)
- [ ] 7. **No fake progress from pixels:** An animation playing, a spinner disappearing or a “Saved” toast does not independently prove a file was saved. Prefer native readback, saved-file parse/hash, API confirmation, durable app/job receipts and independent verifier checks. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1956)
- [ ] 8. **Failure and degradation:** On capture loss, model rate limit, app permission denial, OCR failure, plugin crash or high system load, preserve last verified facts with stale labels, continue only safe native operations and show blocked/unknown status. Never secretly switch to full-desktop capture or an unauthorized model to keep the UI animated. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1957)

The bar derives state from events, not from model-generated prose. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L1990)

Use ephemeral local ring buffers for video, bounded retention for screenshots, encrypted account-scoped credentials and privacy-safe diagnostics. ## 7. Part 27 — ALL twelve revised R12 abilities + four packages + eight products

### R12-01 — Live / Background Mode (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-01 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2212)
- [ ] - **Exact UI:** One compact two-option dropdown labeled **Live** and **Background**, shown in the relevant task/agent controls (website and app-attached overlay where appropriate), with current mode, status and a short plain-language explanation. Do not expose separate "cloud", "dual", "hidden desktop" or "VM" modes as the primary customer decision. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2214)
- [ ] - **Live:** The user can see the AI's real work and per-agent colored, action-backed cursors on the target application, subject to actual window/capture/OS capabilities. If GUI input is needed, request a deliberate time-limited handoff for the target app; user STOP/Take Over wins. The shared OS pointer/keyboard is arbitrated, while other independent agents can still work concurrently. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2215)
- [ ] - **Background:** Execute authorized work on the customer's own machine via supported native app APIs, installed plugins, local scripts, CLI/headless processes, separate browser contexts and transactional file changes without disturbing the customer's current app, mouse, typing, gaming or video. Respect CPU/GPU/RAM, thermal, battery and fullscreen limits. GUI-only focus-dependent steps must wait, ask for Live or report unsupported. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2216)
- [ ] - **Transitions:** Switching modes preserves project/task IDs, grants, checkpoints, work graph and accepted outputs; it does not restart independent work or duplicate external effects. Show "Waiting for Live control" when necessary, not fake background progress. Distinguish background work that is actively executing from queued/paused. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2217)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Mode switching during render, typing, fullscreen game, app minimize, agent STOP, lost focus and permission revocation; verify no unintended OS input or duplicate job, and truthful task continuity. Integrate with Part 14F.2–14F.6. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2218)

### R12-02 — Smart Approvals (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-02 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2220)
- [ ] - **Default:** No repetitive approval popup for each ordinary click, file read, navigation, app script, local draft, form field or reversible edit already covered by a scoped task grant. Use a short initial scope summary: who/which account, app, folders/sites, operation types, destinations, time/usage limits and STOP. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2222)
- [ ] - **Escalation:** Request a single focused approval when the actual operation would transfer money, delete important data, publish/deploy, send sensitive data externally, sign/submit a legally consequential claim, change security permissions, share with a new recipient, purchase something, expose secrets, or materially exceed the existing grant. Differentiate a harmless form draft from final submission. Never hide the provider's own MFA/OAuth/OS dialogs. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2223)
- [ ] - **Approval quality:** Show exact action, target, recipient/domain, data category, irreversible consequences, cost if any, current state and alternatives. Offer approve once, narrowly bounded batch (where defensible), edit, deny and STOP. Avoid broad "always allow everything" for consequential effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2224)
- [ ] - **Durable authority:** Store scoped consent receipts, expiry, idempotency and revoke/STOP epochs in the existing permission authority. If the target/account/data/recipient changes, re-evaluate the effect before commit. A subagent inherits only approved scope and cannot self-approve. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2225)
- [ ] - **Tests:** A 50-step benign authorized task should not generate 50 prompts; a newly discovered sensitive external send must still block; expired/denied/changed scopes must fence all subagents. No repeated prompt loops after refusal. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2226)

### R12-03 — Intelligent Privacy (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-03 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2228)
- [ ] - **Correct owner meaning:** OCADE MAY read and fill the user's **real bank details** and other sensitive task data when specifically authorized and needed for the requested work. It must not replace needed values with stars or fictitious placeholders inside the authorized form. Protect data from unnecessary external recipients and models rather than making the actual task impossible. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2230)
- [ ] - **Field-level purpose binding:** Each sensitive value carries source/account, user grant, purpose, target site/form, permitted recipient, retention and destination. Keep values locally where possible; send only the necessary fields to the intended legitimate service. Redact irrelevant values from LLM prompts, screenshots, screen-share previews, task history, diagnostics, notifications and third-party integrations. Never transmit raw banking credentials, MFA codes or secrets to arbitrary models/tools. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2231)
- [ ] - **Financial boundaries:** Reading balances, statements, invoice data and account numbers and pre-filling authorized forms are separate from executing payments. Do not store card CVV, PIN or online banking passwords as habitual memory; never bypass bank anti-bot/MFA rules. Require user authentication where the bank demands it. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2232)
- [ ] - **User controls:** Clear privacy preview, what leaves the device, which model/provider receives it, selective field sharing, revoke, delete/retention, audit and separate explicit permission for ongoing financial account access. Existing BYOK data-location/funding isolation remains intact. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2233)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Real authorized field is filled accurately at the intended destination; unrelated provider, worker, model, analytics and logs see masked/absent value; revoke mid-task prevents new exposure; no hidden external sharing. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2234)

### R12-04 — Seamless Tool Access (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-04 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2236)
- [ ] - **Connect once, work continuously within scope:** Search/discover supported plugins, skills, MCP tools, local apps and OAuth accounts; connect with provider-required consent once, select resource/account scope and allow OCADE to call the permitted actions across one task or an explicitly scoped ongoing workflow without approval for every harmless tool call. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2238)
- [ ] - **No needless restrictions:** Remove artificial UI friction, duplicate "allow this tool" prompts, separate plugin approval loops and re-selection of the same authorized account. Do NOT remove actual provider OAuth, platform scopes, security validation, token renewal, rate limits, purchase controls or high-risk confirmations. Tool results are untrusted data. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2239)
- [ ] - **Unified capability catalog:** Use the existing Part 14E searchable registry for provider, publisher identity, verified action schema, input/output, cost, scope, supported regions, account selection, token health, permission requirements and current capabilities. One task may combine several tools without multiple unrelated agent frameworks. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2240)
- [ ] - **Lifecycle:** Connection state and grant are inspectable/revocable; expired credentials pause affected work, not unrelated agents; new scope/account/recipient requires an understandable update. Failed/retried tools use idempotency and independent effect checks. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2241)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Multi-tool benign workflow runs after one scoped connection without approval spam; revoked plugin cannot execute from queued subagent; malicious tool output cannot grant filesystem/network permissions; correct account/tenant is used. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2242)

### R12-05 — Animated Permission Guide (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-05 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2244)
- [ ] - **Exact look and controls:** A restrained premium **glass-gradient** onboarding/repair overlay with clear short animated instructions, highlighted relevant OS/browser/app settings, current step, expected permission, reason, progress, Retry/Verify, optional "Open settings", accessible text alternative and an obvious **top-right × close button**. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2246)
- [ ] - **Real permission state:** Explain Windows/macOS screen capture, Accessibility, app automation, filesystem/folder, microphone/camera (only if used), browser profile and connector OAuth separately. Where OS APIs permit, open the genuine system settings pane; where they do not, show accurate user-driven steps. Never fake a permission grant or click through secure OS consent on behalf of the user. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2247)
- [ ] - **Interaction:** Respect reduced motion, screen readers, high contrast, keyboard Escape, safe areas, small windows and mixed-DPI displays. Highlight only a confirmed current setting or actual UI region; avoid stale coordinates and misleading pulsing over the wrong application. × closes the guide without silently granting/denying anything or stopping already-authorized unrelated work. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2248)
- [ ] - **Recovery:** Remember completed steps by permission/version/device, explain "Denied", "Pending", "Needs restart", "Not supported" and "Revoked", and avoid showing the same guide repeatedly after the permission is already verified. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2249)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Windows/macOS denied and reauthorized flows, OS updates, reduced motion, guide close/reopen, wrong window, disconnected device, accessibility navigation and no misleading success states. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2250)

### R12-06 — Live App Generator (P0 platform, P1 expanded coverage).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-06 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2252)
- [ ] - **Goal:** Automatically turn complicated websites, enterprise software and native app workflows into a **beautiful, simple, task-specific generated form** that asks only for the fields required to accomplish the user's objective. It is a temporary, verified interaction layer over the authorized target, not a new independent hosted application or a bypass of the original site's rules. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2254)
- [ ] - **Build:** Discover current authorized DOM/accessibility/native app form schema, validation rules, labels, required fields, options, dependencies, attachments, dynamic sections, account/recipient identity and final action semantics. Generate a typed JSON-schema-like internal representation and OCADE design-system form with clear sections, field help, defaults from authorized context, edit/review, errors, draft save and provenance for auto-filled values. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2255)
- [ ] - **Execute:** Map generated fields back to verified current target controls or official APIs; revalidate against current site/app state before fill and submit. Handle conditional fields, multi-step pages, document uploads, captcha/MFA/user-only challenges, validation messages and unsupported controls honestly. Do not hallucinate fields or submit if target mapping is uncertain. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2256)
- [ ] - **Safety:** Routine fill can proceed within scope; final submission that sends sensitive data, incurs fees, creates legal obligations or changes accounts requires the correct approval. Generated UI must show original destination and exact data to be sent. Never conceal required disclosures or manipulate choices. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2257)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Complex dynamic form simplifies without losing required fields, values round-trip exactly, user edits persist, changed source form invalidates stale mapping, and the original site independently confirms success. Accessible on mobile/desktop. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2258)

### R12-07 — Automatic Context Discovery (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-07 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2260)
- [ ] - **Replace Smart Dropzones as primary workflow:** The user should not have to manually drag relevant documents into a special Smart Dropzone for ordinary tasks. OCADE discovers relevant **already-authorized** files, folders, browser tabs, connected accounts, app projects, calendars and open applications using the shared capability/context graph. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2262)
- [ ] - **Discovery process:** Extract the task intent and needed resource types; search only permissioned scopes; rank by relevance, current project, file metadata, recent activity, user-selected account, app identity and verified content matches. Present the chosen resources and why; ask one targeted question only if ambiguity materially affects correctness or privacy. Support explicit override, exclude, pin and "don't search this location". [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2263)
- [ ] - **Privacy/performance:** No silent full-disk indexing, cross-account scraping, unauthorized folder traversal, blanket cloud upload, persistent monitoring of unrelated tabs or automatic opening of sensitive files. Minimize file contents sent to models; use local metadata/content indices only with proper grants and retention. Respect OS and provider APIs. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2264)
- [ ] - **Backward compatibility:** Preserve any existing Smart Dropzone references and accepted upload flows as optional manual overrides if they exist; remove the REQUIREMENT that users must use them, not historical plan text or functioning accessibility pathways. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2265)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Task discovers correct authorized invoice/project without manual upload; denies unauthorized directories; handles two similarly named files with a clarification; detects stale/moved files; no unrelated data appears in logs or prompts. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2266)

### R12-08 — Passive Ghost Preview (P0).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-08 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2268)
- [ ] - **Behavior:** Show a nonblocking preview of the AI's **next planned meaningful action** (e.g., "Will add three invoice reminders", "Next: update Blender lighting", "Preparing claim draft") in the app-scoped overlay or website task view. Ordinary authorized actions require **no approval buttons**; preview is informational and can be collapsed/hidden. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2270)
- [ ] - **Truth:** Distinguish "Planned", "Executing", "Completed", "Blocked" and "Needs confirmation" from actual event receipts. If the plan changes, update the preview. Do not show speculative cursor animation as evidence of an executed action or imply certainty when the target app has changed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2271)
- [ ] - **Interaction:** Optional inspect, change instruction, pause, STOP and Take Over remain accessible. If the next effect is sensitive/out-of-scope, surface the normal Smart Approval control separately; do not turn every preview into a permission dialog. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2272)
- [ ] - **Scope:** App-only by default; pinned redacted summary only when explicitly enabled; no preview over unrelated games, password managers or OS secure surfaces. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2273)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Preview accurately predicts next authorized step, updates on replan, cannot accidentally authorize a high-risk action, has minimal latency/CPU cost and does not steal focus. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2274)

### R12-09 — Time-Travel Timeline (P0 history, P1 safe restoration).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-09 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2276)
- [ ] - **Goal:** Let users inspect completed steps, errors, agent actions, revisions, files, approvals, external effects and recovery points in one chronological task timeline. Filter by agent, app, resource, status and time; link entries to actual receipts and changed artifacts. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2278)
- [ ] - **Checkpoints:** Before significant reversible edits, preserve a safe version/undo point where supported; show "View before", "Compare", "Restore draft" and "Resume from checkpoint" only when technically valid. Coordinate restoration with other agents and newer user edits; never silently roll back accepted work. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2279)
- [ ] - **Irreversible boundary:** A sent email, bank transaction, published page, externally submitted job application or deleted remote record may NOT be reversible. Label "Recorded only / cannot undo" and offer a corrective workflow where possible, not a fake time machine. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2280)
- [ ] - **Security:** Timeline metadata and previews are tenant/user scoped; sensitive fields are masked, access to underlying originals is permission-checked, retention and delete controls are honored. Offline local journal and server journal reconcile by IDs, sequence and STOP epoch. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2281)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Multi-agent concurrent events appear in causal order, partial failures and retries are visible, safe local file restore succeeds, irreversible external effects cannot be mislabeled undoable, and stale checkpoint restore is rejected. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2282)

### R12-10 — Private Habit Intelligence (P1 opt-in).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-10 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2284)
- [ ] - **Goal:** Learn the individual's recurring workflows and preferred choices from that user's **consented, verified** task history; offer useful one-click repeats, prefilled templates, suggestions and optional scheduled routines.
