No cross-user memory sharing, pooled personal histories, default public training or accidental organization-to-personal leakage. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2286)
- [ ] - **Memory boundary:** User-specific, purpose-bound, inspectable, editable, exportable and forgettable. Store workflow patterns and verified preferences rather than raw passwords, PINs, MFA tokens, bank secrets or complete private documents. If user memory is disabled, no habit learning or covert reconstitution through another store. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2287)
- [ ] - **Automation:** A recognized habit is a recommendation, not authority to run it indefinitely. Recurring actions require a separate approved schedule, resources, audience, data and revocation. Sensitive sends, financial actions, changed recipients and new permissions remain confirmation-gated. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2288)
- [ ] - **Quality:** Require repeated verified evidence before suggesting a pattern; label confidence and allow "not relevant", "never suggest" and correction. Avoid manipulative nudges, excessive notifications and false predictions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2289)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Two users with identical workflows never share memory, disabled memory leaves no new habit record, forget/revoke works across devices, and no saved habit bypasses action permissions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2290)

### R12-11 — Simplification Mode (P0 basic, P1 broad app coverage).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-11 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2292)
- [ ] - **Goal:** Make confusing websites and installed applications easier to understand and operate without forcing the user to learn their entire interface. Provide an optional contextual simplified view: clear next step, essential controls, explanations, accessible navigation, form generation and task-specific guidance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2294)
- [ ] - **Architecture:** Build on Live App Generator, semantic DOM/accessibility/native app state and OCADE's app-attached overlay. Use one capability and permission model; do not create an unsupported universal replacement shell that claims to work for every custom GPU canvas or closed app. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2295)
- [ ] - **Truth and fidelity:** Preserve actual form validation, required disclosures, selected account, original destination, data values, accessibility, user control and final confirmation. Show a "View original" path and allow instant exit. Do not conceal fees, terms, risk, error states or uneditable source content. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2296)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Novice user completes a representative complex authorized task with fewer errors/steps than original, and a source UI update triggers revalidation rather than silent wrong-field actions; keyboard and screen-reader use remain functional. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2297)

### R12-12 — Cross-Device Handoff (P1).

- [ ] Implement the COMPLETE R12-12 contract and all positive/negative acceptance cases with actual UI, permissions, recovery and app behavior. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2299)
- [ ] - **Goal:** Continue one OCADE task across the **website, phone/mobile web experience and authorized Windows/macOS desktop companion** without losing the plan, conversation, accepted artifacts, timeline, approvals, agent status or pending instructions. Do not promise a native iOS/Android app unless one is actually built. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2301)
- [ ] - **Task identity:** Reuse one durable task ID, revisioned event stream, authenticated user identity, per-device capability map, resource manifests and encrypted checkpoint metadata. The phone may inspect, reply, approve or redirect where supported; local PC work continues only while its own companion remains paired and authorized. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2302)
- [ ] - **Security:** Device pairing and resource access are separate. A phone login does not grant the phone raw local disk access or remote PC control; a new computer must be explicitly enrolled, its own folders/apps granted and the required data safely transferred or re-discovered. Revalidate identity and step-up for sensitive confirmations; show which device is actually executing. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2303)
- [ ] - **Conflict handling:** Two devices editing the same instruction use revision checks and a clear conflict/rebase UI; preserve unsent drafts. Network outages, reconnects and expired sessions must not duplicate external submissions or silently restart dangerous effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2304)
- [ ] - **Tests:** Start on desktop, inspect/edit from phone, resume website, preserve task/STOP/approval receipts, reject a stolen device token and verify that an unpaired device cannot execute local PC actions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2305)

### Four packages and eight exact user products

- [ ] **Package BMA: Business Money Assistant (P1; two products).** — complete integration, user benefit, real data and artifact proof. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2311)
- [ ] **BMA-01 Invoice Recovery.** — Discover user-authorized invoices, customer records, payment terms, dates, receipts and communications from permitted files, email, bookkeeping/CRM tools or manual entry. Normalize invoice ID, customer, amount, currency, due date, paid/unpaid/partially paid/disputed state and evidence source. Detect unpaid or overdue invoices; propose a ranked follow-up plan; prepare polite personalized reminders and supporting invoice attachments; prevent duplicate sends and messages to the wrong customer. Show a human-readable timeline of reminder drafts, sent receipts and replies. Send only within an explicitly authorized recipient/audience and communication scope; confirm new recipients or sensitive external disclosures. A disputed invoice must not be falsely marked collectible; do not threaten or misstate legal rights. Verify paid status against real authorized evidence, not an LLM guess.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2313)
- [ ] **BMA-02 Cashflow Guardian.** — Read authorized balances, invoice receivables, expense commitments, payroll/rent dates and recurring outflows; produce a transparent cash-in/cash-out calendar, rolling cash runway and conservative/base/optimistic scenarios. Separate confirmed transactions from estimated payments and uncertain assumptions. Flag upcoming cash shortages with date, amount range, source and proposed nonfinancial next actions such as preparing a reminder or reviewing expenses. Never present fabricated bank balances or guaranteed forecasts. Do not execute, schedule or autonomously authorize payments, transfers or purchases.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2314)
- [ ] - **Shared money controls:** Exact currency/timezone, invoice uniqueness, account identity, duplicate/partial payments, reconciliation, retention, redaction, explicit account consent, provider-required MFA, audit receipts and no autonomous payments. Read/fill real authorized bank details only when needed; no hidden transfer or financial account access expansion. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2315)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Seed fixtures include overdue, partial, disputed, duplicate and already-paid invoices; correct classification and reminder drafts; cash forecast arithmetic independently recomputed with missing-data warnings; zero autonomous money movement; correct sensitive-recipient gate. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2316)
- [ ] **Package UFCA: Universal Forms & Claims Assistant (P1; three products).** — complete integration, user benefit, real data and artifact proof. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2318)
- [ ] **UFCA-03 Deadline Guardian.** — Discover deadlines from authorized documents, emails, calendars, claim portals and user input; extract date, timezone, eligibility, requirements, documents, fees and consequences with source citations and confidence. Produce a deadline dashboard, missing-item checklist and user-approved reminders. Handle timezones, business days, changing portal deadlines and uncertain sources; never invent an official date. Calendar writes and notifications must stay within the user's approved scope. An actual application/claim submission remains separately permission-checked.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2320)
- [ ] **UFCA-04 Refund Assistant.** — Discover legitimate order/receipt/return-policy information, eligible refund paths, deadlines and evidence; prepare a claim package, Live App and draft communications; fill supported authorized forms. Verify the official recipient/site and refund destination; show policy uncertainty, fees and expected processing without guaranteeing approval. Confirm before sending sensitive financial/identity data externally or making a consequential claim; never falsify evidence or bypass provider checks. Track submitted case/reference numbers and responses with real receipts.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2321)
- [ ] **UFCA-05 Job Application Assistant.** — Read the user's authorized résumé, portfolio, preferences, experience and selected vacancies; identify requirements, gaps, deadlines and application fields; produce truthful tailored résumés/cover letters and a simple Live App for each site. Never invent qualifications, employment history, certifications or answers; preserve user-approved personal details. Fill forms within scope, but **do not auto-submit sensitive personal data to a new employer without informed user authorization**. Handle external ATS login, captcha/MFA, accessibility, changing forms, duplicate applications and withdrawal limitations. Track actual submission confirmation, not a model's claim.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2322)
- [ ] - **Shared forms architecture:** Source-specific schema/field extraction, generated accessible forms, verified field-to-target mapping, attachment handling, data provenance, saved drafts, explicit sensitive submission gate, deadline events and timeline. Do not clone a target website's visual design or bypass its legal/technical access rules. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2323)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Multiple changing form fixtures, incomplete evidence, different timezones, sensitive external send, official-site mismatch, captcha and MFA handoff, duplicate submission prevention, correct receipt/confirmation and honest unsupported states. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2324)
- [ ] **Package PFA: Personal & Family Assistant (P1; two products).** — complete integration, user benefit, real data and artifact proof. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2326)
- [ ] **PFA-06 Micro-Business Ledger.** — Organize authorized receipts, expenses, invoices, categories, clients and simple bookkeeping records into an editable, exportable ledger with source document links, deduplication, date/currency/tax-category uncertainty and audit-friendly correction history. Reconcile totals independently; separate personal and business records by user-selected account/workspace. Support spreadsheet/CSV exports and user-approved accounting integrations. Do not claim to be a licensed accountant, silently file taxes, make payments or alter official financial records without the correct confirmation.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2328)
- [ ] **PFA-07 Family Administration.** — Organize authorized appointments, school/household paperwork, renewals, bills, insurance records, family checklists and reminders. Keep person/household/member permissions separate; a user's access to their own account does NOT automatically authorize reading another adult's records or sharing a child's sensitive information. Use minimal fields, explicit family-resource grants and user-controlled retention. Prepare forms and calendar entries; sensitive disclosure to schools, insurers, clinics or third parties requires the relevant authorization. Do not infer legal guardianship or access rights from a family relationship.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2329)
- [ ] - **Shared privacy:** Personal memory is private per user; household collaboration, if later supported, uses explicit role/resource grants rather than cross-user memory sharing. Protect minors' data, medical/financial fields, recipient identity and calendar visibility. Support export, correction, deletion and offline/local-only modes where supported. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2330)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Mixed-user fixture cannot leak another member's records; duplicate receipts reconcile once; exports preserve correct totals; recurring reminder does not become a perpetual right to send private documents. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2331)
- [ ] **Package BLA: Business Launch Assistant (P1; one product).** — complete integration, user benefit, real data and artifact proof. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2333)
- [ ] **BLA-08 Client Onboarding Autopilot.** — Starting from a user-approved new-client brief, contract or intake form, discover required client details, project type, deliverables, milestones, contacts and source files. Build a complete scoped onboarding workflow: create a project workspace in an authorized existing app, folder/document structure, task plan, milestone dates, owner assignments, welcome draft/materials, resource checklist, delivery checklist and first review/approval gates. Reuse existing project/task engine and connectors; do not create a second client-management backend.. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2335)
- [ ] - **Beyond copying details:** Validate missing client information, conflicting terms, deliverable acceptance criteria, dependencies, budgets, deadlines and access permissions; surface clarifications through a simple Live App. Generate editable project artifacts and independently verify the workspace, tasks and documents actually exist. Preserve client-specific confidentiality and separation from other customers. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2336)
- [ ] - **External effects:** Workspace creation and internal drafts can run automatically within granted scope. Inviting a new client, granting folder access, sending a welcome email with sensitive details, buying a SaaS plan or accepting a contract requires the relevant explicit approval and official provider authentication. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2337)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Authorized fixture creates a complete editable workspace/task plan/checklist from a brief, no wrong-client leakage, no duplicate invitations after retry, missing data shown honestly, and all external recipients/access grants verified. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2338)
- [ ] 1. **Capability discovery and routing:** Extend the existing capability catalog with authorized resource inventories (files/folders, open tabs, apps/projects, connected accounts, calendars, invoices, form schemas), current availability, provider identity, source provenance, permission scope, supported actions, risk classification, cost and freshness. Smart Dropzone is optional, not required. A context candidate is not automatically an authorization grant. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2342)
- [ ] 2. **Consent and effect gate:** Existing task authority stores grant_id, principal/tenant, account, device, task/project, allowed action classes, target resource roots/domains, permitted recipients, sensitive field categories, model funding/data destinations, expiry, revocation generation, user confirmation receipts and idempotency keys. Gate every tool effect at execution time, including replay, delegated agents, generated forms, plugin tools and resumed devices. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2343)
- [ ] 3. **Privacy-aware dataflow:** Use typed field provenance and purpose/destination tags. A bank field may flow from authorized source to authorized target form but not to unrelated remote model/log/preview. The gateway performs minimization/redaction before external inference; task engine still has exact authorized local values when necessary. Test with canary secrets and cross-tenant isolation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2344)
- [ ] 4. **Live App schema and renderer:** Extend existing website design-system components with typed field schema, conditional dependencies, validation, origin and source links, mapped target controls, consent requirements, draft persistence and verified execution receipts. Reuse in invoice follow-up, refunds, claims, job applications, onboarding and simplification; no domain-specific copy-paste form engines. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2345)
- [ ] 5. **Preview and timeline:** Emit one versioned action/event stream: intent → plan → scoped authorization → planned next action → executing → receipt → independently verified/uncertain/failed → checkpoint/restore eligibility. Ghost Preview subscribes to next safe action; Time-Travel Timeline subscribes to history; agent overlay subscribes to current execution. They must not maintain contradictory duplicate progress models. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2346)
- [ ] 6. **Habit intelligence:** Build an opt-in private workflow-pattern view over accepted task history, with strict per-user/tenant RLS, no shared personal embeddings, explicit retention/forget and separate authorization for any scheduled repetition. No default personal-data pooling for model training or other customers. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2347)
- [ ] 7. **Cross-device continuity:** Use one durable server task ID, signed paired-device identities, scoped device capabilities, event sequence/revision, local companion lease, conflict resolution and encrypted references to artifacts. Mobile is a UI participant; the Windows/macOS companion remains the local executor when PC work is required. Re-enroll/regrant on a new computer. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2348)
- [ ] 8. **Permission guide:** Use one UI component for onboarding and repair with OS-specific capability checks, real provider/OS permission state, accessible glass-gradient presentation, close button, no spoofed system dialogs and no bypass of secure screens. Do not embed an independent native settings framework. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2349)
- [ ] 9. **Four package templates:** Implement domain workflow definitions, input/output schemas, required capabilities, permitted action categories, consent rules, verification oracles and reusable UI templates on the SAME orchestration spine. A package may require connectors the user has not installed; show honest capability-dependent setup and a manual alternative. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2350)
- [ ] 10. **Data model discipline:** Before adding tables, inspect current schema/RLS/migrations. Prefer additive typed columns or narrowly scoped tables for grants, generated form mappings, context candidates, timeline/checkpoints, user-only habits, handoff and package instances only if existing tables cannot represent them safely. Never duplicate tokens, project state or personal memory into product-specific databases. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2351)
- [ ] 11. **Provider and tool boundaries:** Existing BYOK/owner-funded gateway must approve any model used for form understanding, habit suggestion or financial text extraction. No silent paid provider fallback. Official OAuth/MCP restrictions and provider rate limits remain binding even when the UI avoids repeated approvals. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2352)
- [ ] 12. **Operational reliability:** Agent STOP, Take Over, lease fencing, network loss, task replay, retries, provider expiry, OS permission changes and user edits apply consistently across all twelve additions and eight products. Every consequential effect has an independently verifiable receipt or remains explicitly uncertain. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2353)
- [ ] 1. **One calm default screen:** A user types "Recover unpaid invoices", "Apply to this job", "Organize family paperwork" or another outcome. OCADE finds authorized resources and offers one best next step. Optional package templates appear in contextual discovery, not eight top-level product tabs or a giant onboarding questionnaire. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2357)
- [ ] 2. **Mode dropdown:** Two options only, Live and Background; show a concise availability note ("Background available" / "This step needs Live control") without a technical lecture. Do not hide the true requirement for user input or misrepresent device resource usage. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2358)
- [ ] 3. **Smart Approvals:** Initial scoped consent is compact and legible; routine execution continues. A consequential approval is specific, local to the relevant action, clear about recipient and data, and distinguishable from a passive preview. Do not turn denial into repeated nagging. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2359)
- [ ] 4. **Animated guide:** Glass-gradient, subtle step transitions, highlighted setting, top-right ×, Retry/Verify, keyboard and reduced-motion support. It must explain rather than impersonate system permission dialogs. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2360)
- [ ] 5. **Generated forms:** Ask only necessary questions; show where auto-filled answers came from; preserve draft and edits; validate inline; reveal advanced fields only when necessary. Original target/source remains inspectable. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2361)
- [ ] 6. **Discovery:** Present top relevant authorized resource with confidence/provenance and an easy Change/Exclude action. No hidden mass indexing; one clarification when ambiguity changes the answer. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2362)
- [ ] 7. **Ghost Preview:** Compact next-action text with real agent/target, no ordinary approval buttons, no fake action animation. STOP and edit instruction remain accessible. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2363)
- [ ] 8. **Timeline:** Clear chronological grouping, current checkpoint, error and recovery state, safe undo versus cannot-undo. No misleading "time travel" restoration of external effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2364)
- [ ] 9. **Habit suggestions:** Nonintrusive, opt-in, user-correctable; no repeated promotional prompts. Personalization never expands permissions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2365)
- [ ] 10. **Simplification:** Familiar visual hierarchy, short field groups, simple explanation, "View original" and instant exit. Avoid hiding legal disclosures or errors. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2366)
- [ ] 11. **Handoff:** Same conversation/task and truthful current executor; phone UI must be touch-accessible; clearly show when desktop companion is offline or unavailable. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2367)
- [ ] 12. **Law-by-law application:** Audit UX-01–UX-34 from Part 14B.4 and Appendix G.1, particularly Fitts (STOP/×/approve targets), Hick (two-mode dropdown and package choices), Progressive Disclosure (generated forms/agent details), Doherty (immediate honest acknowledgments), Cognitive Load/Chunking (simplified forms), Jakob (familiar OS permission guidance), Working Memory (drafts and handoff), Zeigarnik/Goal Gradient (real milestones), Peak-End (verified deliverables), Flow (noninterruptive tool use), Occam (one shared engine), and accessibility/contrast/reduced motion. Record screen-specific evidence and justified nonapplicability rather than claiming every law has the same UI effect. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2368)
- [ ] - **A01:** Ordinary 50-action task completes after one scoped grant with no approval spam; one sensitive external send pauses at the exact effect boundary. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2380)
- [ ] - **A02:** Authorized bank details fill correctly in a legitimate target form; unrelated provider/model/log/worker cannot see those values; no payment executes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2381)
- [ ] - **A03:** Reused OAuth/plugin scope works across a multi-tool task; revoked/expired/new-account scopes stop only affected operations; provider consent/MFA is never bypassed. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2382)
- [ ] - **A04:** Live/Background switch during concurrent local work preserves task and user input; background GUI-only action waits for handoff rather than stealing focus. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2383)
- [ ] - **A05:** Glass-gradient permission guide is accurate, closable at top-right ×, accessible, reduced-motion compatible and never fakes OS permission state. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2384)
- [ ] - **A06:** Generated Live App simplifies a changing multistep form, preserves exact values/required fields, revalidates mapping and independently verifies real submission when approved. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2385)
- [ ] - **A07:** Context discovery selects only permitted files/tabs/apps, explains relevance, asks on ambiguity and never searches denied locations. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2386)
- [ ] - **A08:** Ghost Preview is nonblocking, action-backed, current after replan and does not accidentally authorize a sensitive action. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2387)
- [ ] - **A09:** Timeline records causal multi-agent steps, errors and safe checkpoints; restores reversible draft without overwriting later edits; irreversible effects are explicitly not undoable. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2388)
- [ ] - **A10:** Private Habit Intelligence never crosses users/tenants, honors Off/forget and does not convert observed repetition into permission. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2389)
- [ ] - **A11:** Simplification Mode reduces user effort without hiding legal disclosures, errors, recipients or source controls; exiting returns safely to original. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2390)
- [ ] - **A12:** Phone/website/desktop handoff retains one task identity and exact executing device, rejects unpaired devices, resolves concurrent edits and prevents duplicate effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2391)
- [ ] - **B01:** Invoice Recovery correctly handles overdue, paid, partially paid, duplicate and disputed invoices; reminders respect recipient/data scope; no payments. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2392)
- [ ] - **B02:** Cashflow Guardian independently recomputes correct scenario totals, identifies uncertainty and cannot move funds. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2393)
- [ ] - **B03:** Deadline Guardian handles timezones, official sources, missing documents and revised deadlines without invented certainty. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2394)
- [ ] - **B04:** Refund Assistant produces an accurate, evidence-backed draft, correct official recipient and verified submission receipt only after necessary consent. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2395)
- [ ] - **B05:** Job Application Assistant never fabricates qualifications or sends personal details to a new employer without permission; detects duplicate applications. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2396)
- [ ] - **B06:** Micro-Business Ledger reconciles totals and deduplicates receipts, preserves editable exports and source provenance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2397)
- [ ] - **B07:** Family Administration enforces person/household consent boundaries, protects minors' data and does not share documents across users. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2398)
- [ ] - **B08:** Client Onboarding Autopilot creates verified project workspace, tasks, welcome materials and delivery checklist, without unapproved client invitation/access. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2399)
- [ ] - **S01:** Prompt injection through receipts, emails, job ads, web forms, plugin results or OCR cannot expand tool grants, cause payment, leak bank data or cross user boundaries. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2400)
- [ ] - **S02:** STOP, revoked OAuth, network loss, user takeover, stale UI mapping, stale checkpoint, wrong account, provider error and duplicate retry cannot produce unauthorized or repeated external effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2401)
- [ ] - **S03:** UI accessibility: keyboard-only, screen reader, 200% zoom, touch, high contrast, reduced motion, clear ×/STOP, no focus theft and truthful empty/loading/offline states. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2402)
- [ ] - **S04:** Exact-commit source/code/CI evidence and user-visible statuses are recorded separately. DOCUMENTED is not IMPLEMENTED. No benchmarks or release readiness percentages without the existing required coding-complete and independently verified gates. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2403)

## 8. Part 28 — ALL twelve transformative T12 features and ten named technical concepts

### T12-01 — OCADE LifeOS (P1; personal administration workspace)

- [ ] Complete T12-01 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2433)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** A private, coherent view of unfinished personal administration across documents, deadlines, applications, subscriptions, renewals and tasks. This is a workspace within existing OCADE Chat/JARVIS/Library, not a new OS, independent memory engine or replacement file manager. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2435)
- [ ] 2. **Entry and interface:** Show a compact Today / Upcoming / Waiting / Completed view; group obligations by person, project and urgency; allow search, filters, source links, dismiss, edit, snooze and user-created items. Present one best next action with a transparent reason, not an overwhelming dashboard or forced setup. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2436)
- [ ] 3. **Authorized discovery:** Ingest only user-selected or separately consented sources: connected mail, calendar, cloud storage, local folders, open applications, receipts and forms. Every item records source account/resource, retrieval time, freshness, confidence, owner, visibility and permission scope. A connected service is not permission to index all its contents. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2437)
- [ ] 4. **Normalization:** Deduplicate identical obligations across email, calendar and files; preserve distinct versions and conflicting deadlines; represent due date, timezone, amount (if applicable), required evidence, dependency, responsible person and source of truth. Unknown deadlines remain UNKNOWN, not fabricated. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2438)
- [ ] 5. **Actions:** Prepare checklists, draft forms and messages, request missing information, schedule authorized reminders, launch existing package workflows and link Proof Passports. A LifeOS card is not authority to submit, purchase, cancel, delete or share externally. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2439)
- [ ] 6. **Data and privacy:** Tenant/user-scoped records, encryption, access controls, selective retention and export/delete; household records require explicit per-person grants. Do not infer legal ownership of a shared file from its presence on a device. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2440)
- [ ] 7. **Failures:** Expired account, inaccessible document, stale calendar, duplicate obligation, conflicting sources and missing timezone yield visible uncertainty and an actionable repair path; keep prior verified facts without claiming fresh monitoring. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2441)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Two test users with overlapping filenames never see each other's cards; duplicate sources yield one obligation with both citations; timezone correction updates reminder; revoked source stops new reads; user can export/delete LifeOS data without deleting unrelated task history. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2442)

### T12-02 — Outcome Autopilot (P1 after single-task reliability; persistent authorized goals)

- [ ] Complete T12-02 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2444)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Set an ongoing outcome such as “keep invoices followed up weekly” or “prepare required renewal documents” once; OCADE continues only within explicit, revocable scope rather than needing repeated prompts. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2446)
- [ ] 2. **Goal contract:** Store goal ID, desired measurable outcome, permitted source/resource IDs, action classes, recipient/audience, schedule/event triggers, budget and rate limits, quiet hours, expiration, confirmation policy, success check, stop condition and owner. Display the contract in plain language before activation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2447)
- [ ] 3. **State machine:** DRAFT → AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION → ACTIVE → CHECKING → WORKING → VERIFYING → COMPLETED / PAUSED / BLOCKED / EXPIRED / REVOKED. Recurring goals may return to ACTIVE after a verified cycle; one-off goals do not silently become perpetual subscriptions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2448)
- [ ] 4. **Triggers:** Time schedule, authorized connector webhook, permitted local change event or user instruction. Deduplicate events by source event ID and observation version; no constant cloud-model polling when an event, cached result or deterministic check suffices. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2449)
- [ ] 5. **Execution:** Reuse the existing task graph, effect gate, skill replay and verifier. Allow harmless in-scope reads/drafts to continue; any new recipient, larger amount, newly sensitive source, irreversible submission or changed grant requires renewed confirmation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2450)
- [ ] 6. **Cost and autonomy:** Enforce per-run and rolling spend/call ceilings, BYOK ownership, maximum parallelism, failure/retry caps and provider rate limits; stop or ask if a budget would be exceeded. No autonomous payments. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2451)
- [ ] 7. **Visibility:** One compact active-goal list with last check, next check, what changed, verified outcome, cost and Pause/Stop/Revoke. Explain “no change detected” separately from “could not check”. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2452)
- [ ] 8. **Recovery:** On offline device, revoked token, missed schedule or unknown external effect, persist the event and safely resume/reconcile; never replay a consequential action whose outcome is unknown. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2453)
- [ ] 9. **Acceptance:** A recurring invoice task runs once per scheduled cycle, does not duplicate an email on reconnect, obeys quiet hours and recipient scope, pauses on revoked authorization and never exceeds its atomic budget. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2454)

### T12-03 — Problem Radar (P1; consented proactive detection)

- [ ] Complete T12-03 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2456)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Detect relevant problems before the user notices them: missing documents, approaching deadlines, inconsistent records, failed automations, unverified submissions and expired connections. Offer an evidence-backed fix, or perform a previously authorized low-risk correction. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2458)
- [ ] 2. **Consent boundary:** Explicit per-source monitoring opt-in with exact category, cadence, data retention and alert destination. No covert always-on microphone, full-desktop capture, indiscriminate mail scanning or monitoring of unselected people/accounts. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2459)
- [ ] 3. **Detection engine:** Deterministic rules first (deadline arithmetic, missing required fields, mismatch in invoice totals, stale connection, task-state timeout, checksum changes); use an authorized model only for ambiguous semantic interpretation. Preserve source evidence and confidence. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2460)
- [ ] 4. **Signal model:** Finding ID, rule/version, observed resource, evidence, severity, confidence, first/last seen, duplicate fingerprint, remediation candidate, owner and resolved/snoozed status. Suppress repeat alerts unless severity, evidence or deadline materially changes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2461)
- [ ] 5. **User experience:** One concise issue card: “what changed / why it matters / evidence / recommended fix / next deadline / fix or dismiss.” Distinguish observed facts from forecasts and speculation. Respect quiet hours and alert-frequency budgets. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2462)
- [ ] 6. **Actions:** Open existing LifeOS item, create Deadline Guardian reminder, propose a Refund/Forms workflow, repair a failed task, or run an already-authorized reversible fix. No new external submission or sensitive disclosure without required confirmation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2463)
- [ ] 7. **Abuse resistance:** Prompt-injected emails/documents cannot create new monitors, change severity rules, grant access or authorize spending. A false positive must be dismissible and teach the detector only within the user's private preferences. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2464)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Detect a synthetic missing attachment and impending deadline; suppress duplicates; show exact evidence; reject ungranted folder monitoring; a revoked connector stops checks; uncertain findings never display as confirmed facts. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2465)

### T12-04 — Business-in-a-Box (P1/P2; coherent small-business operations)

- [ ] Complete T12-04 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2467)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** An AI-assisted operations workspace for small businesses using their EXISTING software for invoicing, receivables, reconciliation, client records, onboarding and administration. It packages the approved Business Money Assistant, Business Launch Assistant and relevant forms/ledger workflows; it does not replace those four packages. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2469)
- [ ] 2. **Onboarding:** Identify business entity, jurisdiction, role, connected accounting/CRM/mail/project apps, customer records, currencies, fiscal calendar, invoice numbering and permitted users. Show supported integrations honestly; do not pretend a legacy app has an API. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2470)
- [ ] 3. **Workflows:** Import/reconcile invoices, identify overdue balances, prepare polite collection messages, flag cashflow risks, update authorized CRM records, organize receipts, onboard clients and create verified project workspaces. Link the eight Part 27 products rather than duplicating their engines. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2471)
- [ ] 4. **Shared data:** Normalize customers, invoices, payments received, expenses, tasks, projects, document references and external IDs with provenance and account-scoped versioning. Do not overwrite an accounting system's authoritative ledger without a validated update path. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2472)
- [ ] 5. **Roles and collaboration:** Owner/admin/operator/viewer with per-business and per-resource grants; prevent an employee from inheriting a business owner's personal banking access. Support separation of duties for high-impact actions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2473)
- [ ] 6. **Financial restrictions:** OCADE may read and prepare permitted financial information but cannot autonomously transfer funds, pay invoices, make purchases or represent estimated cashflow as guaranteed. Sensitive client disclosure and new outbound recipients require appropriate consent. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2474)
- [ ] 7. **Reliability:** Idempotent imports, reconciliation reports, conflict resolution, dry-run previews for bulk edits, checkpoints and source-of-truth readback. Export interoperable records; do not lock users into proprietary unexportable formats. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2475)
- [ ] 8. **Commercial boundary:** Pilot one narrowly defined professional workflow first; do not claim universal accountant replacement, regulatory compliance, guaranteed debt collection or positive ROI without observed evidence. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2476)
- [ ] 9. **Acceptance:** Correctly reconcile paid/partial/disputed invoices, detect duplicate imported receipts, isolate two businesses, create one verified onboarding workspace, block unauthorized mass mail and prove no autonomous payment path exists. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2477)

### T12-05 — Opportunity Engine (P1/P2; relevant opportunities without spam)

- [ ] Complete T12-05 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2479)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Discover suitable jobs, clients, grants and business opportunities; explain fit; prepare truthful applications or outreach; require the correct authorization before external submission. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2481)
- [ ] 2. **Profile:** User-controlled skills, résumé/portfolio, business capabilities, region, budget, eligibility, preferred sectors, exclusions, availability, desired compensation and application history. Mark inferred preferences as editable suggestions, not verified qualifications. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2482)
- [ ] 3. **Discovery:** Use only permitted public sites and connected accounts; respect platform terms, robots/rate limits and anti-spam rules. Record listing URL, publisher, retrieval date, eligibility criteria, location, deadline and whether the listing is still open. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2483)
- [ ] 4. **Ranking:** Show evidence-backed fit and missing requirements; separate explicit requirements from model inference. Filter duplicates, expired opportunities, scams, paid application traps and previously submitted listings. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2484)
- [ ] 5. **Preparation:** Reuse Job Application Assistant and Live App Generator for resumes, cover letters, grants, proposals and client onboarding drafts. Never invent credentials, references, experience, financial statements or certifications. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2485)
- [ ] 6. **Submission boundary:** External sends, applications, bids, sensitive attachments and any fees follow Part 27 effect policy; default to user review for new recipients and legally consequential attestations. Never buy applications, pay fees or auto-submit high-volume spam. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2486)
- [ ] 7. **Tracking:** Track draft, reviewed, submitted, externally confirmed, response received, closed and unknown states, with real receipts and source references. No “applied” status from a clicked button alone. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2487)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Reject an expired grant and a fake credential requirement; detect a duplicate job; draft an accurate application; require consent for external submission; preserve a real receipt; stop when source access is revoked. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2488)

### T12-06 — Work Simulation (P1; safe rehearsal before consequential changes)

- [ ] Complete T12-06 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2490)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Rehearse a potentially destructive or expensive workflow on a copy, preview or safe environment and show the likely differences before modifying real resources. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2492)
- [ ] 2. **Eligibility:** Classify each planned step as pure/read-only, locally copyable, API dry-run capable, sandboxable, externally irreversible or NOT SIMULATABLE. Never claim a real bank transfer, email delivery, government submission or live third-party action was safely simulated when no faithful sandbox exists. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2493)
- [ ] 3. **Simulation plan:** Capture resource identity/version, permissions, dependencies, expected preconditions, predicted side effects, validation checks, cost and rollback limits. Use versioned temporary files, application-native previews, test tenants or provider-supported sandbox endpoints when available. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2494)
- [ ] 4. **Isolation:** No live recipients, payment rails, real production credentials or accidental network writes in a rehearsal. Enforce filesystem/process/network restrictions; explicitly label any simulation that cannot isolate external calls. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2495)
- [ ] 5. **Diff and preview:** Show before/after files, records, UI state, totals, recipients, permissions and expected irreversible effects. Distinguish deterministic verified diffs from AI-predicted or approximate effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2496)
- [ ] 6. **Promotion to real execution:** Revalidate actual source revision, target account, grants, recipient, cost and side-effect class immediately before execution. A successful rehearsal is NOT approval to perform a sensitive live effect. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2497)
- [ ] 7. **Failure behavior:** If production differs from the simulated snapshot, invalidate the preview and rerun or ask. On unsupported applications, show “preview unavailable” and rely on narrow direct verification/approval instead of fake certainty. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2498)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Simulated bulk file rename changes only copies; production files stay byte-identical until approved; a changed source version invalidates simulation; an external payment cannot be marked simulated; replaying a simulation never sends real messages. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2499)

### T12-07 — Proof Passport (P1; portable verified outcome evidence)

- [ ] Complete T12-07 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2501)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Every completed consequential task may produce a user-inspectable, portable evidence package showing what changed, what was checked, and what remains uncertain. Extend the existing ELITE-04 Customer ProofPack, task journal, verifier and Part 27 timeline; do not create a second unverifiable receipt service. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2503)
- [ ] 2. **Manifest:** Passport ID, task/goal ID, time, executing device/app version where permitted, authorized resource identifiers, source revision/hash, action summary, output hashes, verifier method/version, checks passed/failed, unresolved exceptions, irreversible effects and evidence expiration. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2504)
- [ ] 3. **Evidence types:** Native API readback, filesystem existence/hash and parse checks, browser/API confirmation, official submission receipts, application-specific assertions and user-acknowledged manual verification. Label each with confidence and scope; a screenshot or model narrative alone does not certify completion. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2505)
- [ ] 4. **Export:** Human-readable concise report plus machine-readable versioned JSON manifest and optional redacted artifacts; interoperable download from Library and optional explicit share. Include integrity hashes and, if a trusted signing key exists, verifiable signatures; do not falsely imply a third-party certification. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2506)
- [ ] 5. **Privacy:** Default redaction of bank numbers, addresses, private documents, tokens, child/medical data and unrelated app content. Allow selective disclosure with exact recipient/scope and expiration where supported. Never include raw secrets in public links or signatures. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2507)
- [ ] 6. **Status:** Distinguish VERIFIED, PARTIALLY VERIFIED, FAILED, UNKNOWN EFFECT and USER-ATTESTED. A future app change or deleted artifact must not retroactively imply a previously verified check was still valid. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2508)
- [ ] 7. **Recovery integration:** Passport links to timeline checkpoints and correction runs; a later fix produces a new linked revision rather than silently editing past evidence. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2509)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Independent verifier recomputes a file hash; manifest cannot say VERIFIED when a check fails; a redacted export contains no sensitive fixture; an altered manifest fails integrity validation; unknown external effect is explicitly UNKNOWN. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2510)

### T12-08 — Recovery Intelligence (P0/P1; verified checkpoint recovery)

- [ ] Complete T12-08 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2512)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Recover from interrupted, failed or partially completed work without losing verified progress or repeating consequential actions. Extend existing checkpointing, task state machine, idempotency keys, STOP fencing, Time-Travel Timeline and Part 14F parallel coordination. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2514)
- [ ] 2. **Checkpoint contract:** Record task/goal ID, worker and lease owner, causal event sequence, dependency versions, source hashes, external action IDs, preconditions, known side effects, durable outputs, permission epoch and last independently verified state. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2515)
- [ ] 3. **Failure taxonomy:** Crash, timeout, network disconnect, stale window, moved file, changed form, revoked connector, expired OAuth, quota, provider error, user takeover, partial write, uncertain submission and concurrent agent conflict. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2516)
- [ ] 4. **Resume algorithm:** Rehydrate verified facts; reacquire current resource/permission leases; reconcile external effects from authoritative readback; skip completed idempotent steps; replan only affected dependencies; revalidate all stale observations. Unknown irreversible effects require investigation or human confirmation, NEVER blind replay. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2517)
- [ ] 5. **User controls:** Resume, retry safe step, view error, restore supported reversible state, hand off to Live, Stop and export diagnostic receipt. State clearly when restoration is impossible. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2518)
- [ ] 6. **Data integrity:** Transactional/atomic file writes where feasible, temporary output cleanup, rollback only for proven reversible changes, immutable event evidence and no cross-user or cross-device checkpoint reuse without new grants. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2519)
- [ ] 7. **Efficiency:** Avoid re-running already verified expensive model calls/renders; cache by authorized input/version and invalidate on changed dependencies. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2520)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Inject crash after an email API success but before local acknowledgment; reconcile one send only. Inject two parallel workers on the same file; one conflict must fail safely. STOP/revocation must prevent resumed side effects; verified outputs survive restart. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2521)

### T12-09 — Personal Knowledge Vault (P1; encrypted user-controlled portable knowledge)

- [ ] Complete T12-09 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2523)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** An inspectable, exportable, encrypted history of user-consented documents, preferences, facts, project knowledge and completed work, private to that user. Extend existing Part 14E private memory and Library rather than constructing a separate shadow memory store. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2525)
- [ ] 2. **Ingestion:** Per-source opt-in and explicit source type (uploaded file, selected folder, permitted connector, task result, user-entered note). Record content owner, provenance, observed time, extraction method, confidence, retention class and source permissions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2526)
- [ ] 3. **Knowledge model:** Separate explicit user facts, inferred preferences, document excerpts, citations and verified task outcomes. Link derived facts back to source versions; avoid silently promoting model guesses into user assertions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2527)
- [ ] 4. **Retrieval:** Tenant/user RLS enforced before retrieval; least relevant necessary snippets only; source authorization checked again at use time; no mixing personal and business or household knowledge without explicit grants. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2528)
- [ ] 5. **Security:** Encrypt at rest and in transit, isolate keys according to the existing security architecture, minimize raw sensitive payloads, never memorize passwords, PINs, MFA codes, card CVVs or unapproved private banking secrets. Do not assert end-to-end encryption unless the deployed key architecture actually provides it. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2529)
- [ ] 6. **Control:** View why a memory was used, correct, forget, source-disable, export in documented interoperable formats, delete and revoke. Explain backup/retention and deletion limitations honestly. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2530)
- [ ] 7. **Model/provider use:** BYOK and provider privacy rules apply; do not send whole vaults to models by default. Prompt injection inside retrieved documents cannot alter policy or tool authority. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2531)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Cross-tenant retrieval tests return zero foreign facts; correcting a false preference changes future suggestions; deleted/disabled source stops retrieval; export is readable and complete for permitted records; token/secret fixtures never enter memory. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2532)

### T12-10 — Human Expert Escalation (P2; explicit qualified specialist handoff)

- [ ] Complete T12-10 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2534)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** When a task reaches a regulated, ambiguous or high-stakes boundary, the user may explicitly request an appropriately qualified human specialist while preserving task context. This is an opt-in referral/handoff workflow, not automatic outsourcing. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2536)
- [ ] 2. **Triggers:** User request, unresolved legal/tax/medical/financial interpretation, contested evidence, repeated verifier failure, inaccessible official process or a consequential decision beyond supported AI authority. Clearly state what OCADE can and cannot verify; do not pretend an expert has been engaged. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2537)
- [ ] 3. **Expert discovery:** If a real partner network is ever launched, verify jurisdiction, professional license/credential where relevant, specialty, availability, conflicts of interest, data handling and fees. Until verified partners exist, offer a user-exportable case packet for the professional of their choice. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2538)
- [ ] 4. **Handoff packet:** User-selected summary, goal, relevant redacted documents, source links, timeline, proof checks, open questions and requested deliverable. Preview EXACTLY what will be shared and with whom. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2539)
- [ ] 5. **Consent and cost:** Separate explicit consent to contact/share; display identity, scope, estimated fees and who pays before any action. No surprise charges, automatic appointments, undisclosed referrals or sharing sensitive data based solely on a model recommendation. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2540)
- [ ] 6. **Boundaries:** Human response is advice or evidence, not an unrestricted new tool grant. Record provenance and user review before applying proposed changes; preserve professional confidentiality and jurisdiction-specific requirements. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2541)
- [ ] 7. **Fallback:** No partner, unverified license, unavailable service, declined consent or unresolved conflict must produce an honest export/self-service path, not a fabricated referral or fake expert answer. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2542)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** A mock unlicensed partner is rejected; zero private files leave before consent; a user can exclude a document; quoted fees remain nonbinding until verified; expert response cannot silently execute a bank payment or delete a file. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2543)

### T12-11 — Verified Skill Network (P1 private / P2 optional sharing)

- [ ] Complete T12-11 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2545)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Convert successful workflows into reusable tested procedures, with optional publication of sanitized skills to others. Extend existing Part 14E Skills, verified-route replay, ELITE-05 Certified Workflow Library and one capability registry. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2547)
- [ ] 2. **Skill schema:** Skill ID/version, author/owner, task intent, parameter types, required app/OS/provider versions, dependencies, requested capabilities, exact permission scopes, cost bounds, action classes, pre/postconditions, supported locales and tests. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2548)
- [ ] 3. **Capture:** Learn from explicit authorized demonstrations or independently verified successful tasks; strip private filenames, account IDs, tokens, prompts containing secrets, user identities and recipient lists. Replace values with typed parameters and resource selectors. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2549)
- [ ] 4. **Verification:** Run synthetic and held-out fixtures, negative permission tests, changed-UI tests, idempotency tests and rollback checks; classify UNVERIFIED, PRIVATE VERIFIED, REVIEWED PUBLIC or QUARANTINED. Publication does not grant automatic trust or execution rights. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2550)
- [ ] 5. **Execution:** Resolve fresh user permissions and current app identity every run; compile deterministic steps when safe; fall back to model reasoning at failed guards. Reject code/tool installation outside the permitted capability sandbox. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2551)
- [ ] 6. **Sharing:** Default private; optional explicit publisher review, license, version signing/integrity, abuse reporting, malware scanning and privacy scrub. No public marketplace or automatic cross-user learning before separate owner approval and security readiness. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2552)
- [ ] 7. **Maintenance:** Detect UI/provider drift, quarantine broken skills, stage repair proposals, regression-test and permit rollback. Never propagate a single user's unverified repair to all users. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2553)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Private skill replays without repeated model clicks; sanitized export has no fixture secrets; revoked connector blocks a skill; changed selector quarantines rather than misclicks; one user's skill never reads another user's memory. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2554)

### T12-12 — Time Reclaimed Dashboard (P1; evidence-based value reporting)

- [ ] Complete T12-12 full contract: input sources, exact authority, UI/actions, privacy and data, failure and independent acceptance. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2556)
- [ ] 1. **User outcome:** Show verified work completed, errors prevented, estimated time reclaimed and actual costs so users can judge OCADE's value. Extend STRAT-05 outcome dashboard and Proof Passport; avoid a separate analytics truth source. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2558)
- [ ] 2. **Metrics:** Completed tasks by verified status, durable artifacts, success/failure/unknown counts, corrections, recoveries, human interventions, actual platform fees, model usage attributable to OCADE where observable and recurring goal outcomes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2559)
- [ ] 3. **Time saved method:** Establish a user-supplied or independently measured manual baseline per task type; subtract measured OCADE supervision and correction time; show estimate, method, sample size and uncertainty. Do not convert arbitrary agent seconds into guaranteed human hours. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2560)
- [ ] 4. **Errors prevented:** Count only a documented detected error with evidence and a prevented or corrected effect; do not infer a prevented fraud or hypothetical loss from a warning alone. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2561)
- [ ] 5. **Money:** Show actual paid platform charges separately from BYOK vendor charges not visible to OCADE; display estimated external fees only when explicitly labeled. Recovered invoice face value is not OCADE revenue or realized customer savings until verified. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2562)
- [ ] 6. **UX:** Simple Today / Week / Month / All Time with expandable per-task receipts, clear zero/unknown states, CSV export and optional private goal comparisons; no manipulative gamification or inflated “10,000×” claims. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2563)
- [ ] 7. **Privacy:** Tenant/user-specific aggregation, consented analytics, minimal telemetry and controls to disable optional reporting; do not publish individual productivity or family activity. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2564)
- [ ] 8. **Acceptance:** Recompute totals from independently verified task fixtures; a failed task does not count as completed; unknown baseline displays “time saved unavailable”; duplicate retries count once; exported report matches on-screen values. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2565)
