### Instant Mini-Apps — generated task-specific forms (P0/P1)

- [ ] Implement and independently test named technical/product concept, or record properly owner-deferred status. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2596)
- [ ] - **Product behavior:** Alias of Part 27 Live App Generator and Simplification Mode: create a temporary, attractive, accessible form for a complex website or desktop application without claiming the original app was replaced. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2598)
- [ ] - **Mapping:** Generate typed fields, dependencies, validation, source references, current-value readback and action bindings from authorized app state; preserve required legal disclosures, error messages and the original-view escape. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2599)
- [ ] - **Safety:** Generated forms cannot silently submit, expand OAuth scopes or bypass provider MFA; map every value to a current target and verify the official result after permitted submission. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2600)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Multi-page conditional form correctly maps required fields; stale mapping blocks submit; screen reader/keyboard use works; the user can switch to original app without losing their draft. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2601)

### Anti-Scam Guardian — evidence-based safety warnings (P1; opt-in)

- [ ] Implement and independently test named technical/product concept, or record properly owner-deferred status. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2603)
- [ ] - **Product behavior:** Warn about suspicious links, look-alike domains, unexpected recipient/payment-detail changes, credential-harvesting forms, malicious document instructions and anomalous external-sharing requests encountered during an AUTHORIZED OCADE workflow. This is not a blanket promise of fraud prevention. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2605)
- [ ] - **Detection:** Use domain/account identity, authenticated source provenance, known safe/blocked indicators, changed payee details, link/redirect analysis and explainable rule evidence. Use model reasoning only for ambiguous signals; report uncertainty and false-positive controls. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2606)
- [ ] - **Intervention:** Pause a suspicious consequential action and show exact evidence and a safe verification path. Do not intercept unrelated browsing or surveil other applications without opt-in. No autonomous money transfers or blanket blocking of legitimate user actions. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2607)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Detect a synthetic invoice payee swap and a look-alike login domain; a trusted but unusual workflow can be reviewed; warning contains source evidence; injected web text cannot suppress checks or authorize sending secrets. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2608)

### Skill Marketplace — conditional optional distribution (P2, NOT approved launch)

- [ ] Implement and independently test named technical/product concept, or record properly owner-deferred status. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2610)
- [ ] - **Product behavior:** A potential catalog for reviewed reusable skills with clear compatibility, publisher, permissions, price (if any), evidence, support and update history. The existing Plugins/Skills directory remains the default UI; do not create a second store or assume a public marketplace is already available. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2612)
- [ ] - **Governance:** Owner approval, actual demand, publisher verification, licensing/IP review, malware/secret scanning, signed/versioned manifests, independent fixture tests, refund/support policy and secure payment integration are prerequisites to any public paid offering. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2613)
- [ ] - **Safety:** No arbitrary downloaded code with unrestricted filesystem/network rights; each installation requires user-scoped grants; revocation, quarantine and incident response must work. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2614)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Unreviewed skill cannot publish; revoked permission blocks execution; malicious manifest is rejected; compatibility and price are never fabricated. This is a conditional research/design track, not a production release requirement until approved. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2615)

### UI Repair Network — safely adapt broken workflows (P2)

- [ ] Implement and independently test named technical/product concept, or record properly owner-deferred status. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2617)
- [ ] - **Product behavior:** Detect when a previously verified workflow fails because an app layout/selector/version changed; propose a locally tested repair and, optionally, distribute a sanitized generalized fix after review. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2619)
- [ ] - **Repair pipeline:** Detect drift → quarantine old skill → observe current authorized UI → propose new semantic selector/action → run negative and positive regression fixtures → verify real postconditions → version and stage release → monitor and roll back. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2620)
- [ ] - **Privacy and security:** Never upload user screenshots, secrets, private URLs or account-specific selectors to other users. Do not assume a successful fix for one account/locale/OS works universally; require compatibility signatures and consent for sharing. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2621)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Changed-site fixture quarantines unsafe automation; repaired skill passes held-out tests; a private user's repair does not expose their data; failed staged update rolls back without duplicate effects. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2622)

### Smart Screen Understanding and dynamic @ picker — named technical priorities (P0)

- [ ] Implement and independently test named technical/product concept, or record properly owner-deferred status. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2624)
- [ ] - **Vision:** Implement Part 14F V01–V10 hybrid perception: native app state, DOM/CDP, accessibility, app-scoped continuous window capture, event/diff gating, selective temporal model analysis, targeted screenshots, OCR parsing and verified replay. One bounded observation stream serves concurrent agents; no requirement to send every local video frame to a cloud model. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2626)
- [ ] - **Context picker:** Reuse Part 14E authorized @ catalog for apps, individual windows/tabs, files, folders, agents and tools. Show exact account/window identity, permissions, freshness and availability; typed @ chips do not grant new access. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2627)
- [ ] - **Acceptance:** Correct app/window target under focus changes, zero denied-resource suggestions, stale-frame refusal, truthful frame/model cost separation, no extra model calls for unchanged frames and successful independently verified saved output. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2628)

### Independent approvals, Background Control and five technical-report priority corrections (P0)

- [ ] Implement and independently test named technical/product concept, or record properly owner-deferred status. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2630)
- [ ] - **Five source priorities, all covered by binding contracts:** Smart screen understanding → Part 14F; learn/replay workflows → ELITE-02/SkillForge; background computer control → Part 14F and Part 27 Live/Background; independent approval system → CheckPoint/Part 27 Smart Approvals; dynamic @ picker → Part 14E/28.2.9. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2632)
- [ ] - **Unified acceptance:** A task can execute authorized native operations in Background without disturbing active keyboard/mouse use, uses only fresh permitted context, resumes after a safe interruption, and requests confirmation only for the correct consequential boundary. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2633)
- [ ] 1. **Personal protection:** Organize subscription/renewal/claims issues, detect consented deadline and scam signals, prepare evidence-backed remedies and show user-controlled next steps. Reuse LifeOS, Problem Radar, Deadline Guardian, Refund Assistant and Anti-Scam Guardian. Do not cancel contracts or share sensitive documents without applicable approval. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2639)
- [ ] 2. **Business cash management:** Reuse Invoice Recovery, Cashflow Guardian, Micro-Business Ledger and Business-in-a-Box; connect real permitted records, show uncertainty, prevent duplicate reminders and NEVER autonomously move money. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2640)
- [ ] 3. **Workflow automation:** Reuse SkillForge, Verified Skill Network, LegacyBridge, Outcome Autopilot, Proof Passport and Recovery Intelligence. Optimize verified cost and completion, not decorative agent counts or raw model throughput. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2641)
- [ ] 4. **Healthcare administration:** Possible future paperwork, scheduling, claims and document organization only with jurisdiction-specific privacy review, explicit user authorization and qualified partner boundaries. Do not diagnose, prescribe, alter treatment, expose family medical data or claim regulated compliance without separate review and approval. This is NOT a currently authorized product launch. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2642)
- [ ] 5. **Enterprise security:** Possible future policy-aware access, verified audit trails, connector least privilege, tenant isolation, safe incident handoff and administrative approvals. Do not introduce intrusive employee surveillance, unrestricted monitoring or a second enterprise permissions engine. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2643)
- [ ] 1. **One authority:** Existing authenticated user/device/task/permission graph is the only source of action authority. All new features call the same capability registry, effect classifier, scoped grants, STOP epoch, task/event journal, model gateway, native companion and verifier. A plugin result, discovered opportunity, memory, skill, monitor or expert packet cannot expand those grants. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2653)
- [ ] 2. **Common records:** Extend existing schemas, after inspecting current migrations, with typed concepts for OutcomeGoal, TriggerSubscription, RadarFinding, LifeObligation, OpportunityRecord, SimulationRun, ProofPassport, RecoveryCheckpoint, KnowledgeSource, ExpertHandoff, SkillVersion and ValueMetric. Prefer additive migrations, tenant/user keys, RLS, source-version hashes, encrypted sensitive fields and idempotency keys; never assume these tables already exist. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2654)
- [ ] 3. **Provenance:** Every decision records the exact authorized source, observed version/time, deterministic rule or model interpretation, confidence, permission and verifier. Unknown is a first-class state. Distinguish planned, simulated, executed, externally confirmed and independently verified. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2655)
- [ ] 4. **Resource arbitration:** Genuinely parallel independent work is allowed only with resource leases and version checks. No simultaneous unarbitrated mutation of one ordinary OS pointer, app window, file or external transaction. Share one app observation engine per authorized session; avoid duplicate capture/model calls across subagents. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2656)
- [ ] 5. **Automation limits:** Persistent goals and monitors need explicit scope, schedules, rate/spend budgets, retention, user pause/revoke and expiry. No silent perpetual authority, no surprise payments, no cross-account data blending, no indefinite background video collection. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2657)
- [ ] 6. **Sensitive effects:** Read/fill authorized real bank data when necessary; minimize external disclosure; money movement, irreversible deletion, sensitive external sharing, legally binding attestations and new recipients require the appropriate independent approval. Never bypass provider MFA, OS permission prompts or account authorization. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2658)
- [ ] 7. **Portable evidence:** Proof Passport and Time Reclaimed Dashboard derive from the SAME verified event stream; the timeline and recovery engine reuse immutable evidence, not untrusted model narration. A simulated action never counts as a completed action. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2659)
- [ ] 8. **Skill safety:** SkillForge capture → parameterized deterministic compiler → local/private verification → guarded execution → drift quarantine → optional sanitized publication. Skill Marketplace/UI Repair Network are P2 conditional paths with explicit governance and separate owner approval before release. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2660)
- [ ] 9. **Expert and regulated boundaries:** Human Expert Escalation is opt-in, real-person and credential-verified where required. Healthcare administration, legal/tax interpretation, financial products and enterprise surveillance require additional jurisdictional, privacy and product reviews; no implicit regulatory certification. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2661)
- [ ] 10. **User experience:** Apply all UX-01–UX-34 at an extreme: one clear next step, progressive disclosure, fast discoverability, minimal interruptions, visible STOP and permissions, meaningful error recovery, truthful status, accessible keyboard/screen reader/touch, reduced motion, responsive mobile/web/desktop handoff, no dark patterns. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2662)
- [ ] 11. **Cost and performance:** Measure wall-clock time to verified outcome, actual model calls/tokens, local CPU/GPU, capture FPS versus analyzed FPS, failed/duplicate external effects, user interruptions, human corrections and provider spend. Targets must be measured on authorized representative tasks; never assert the earlier illustrative numbers as achieved. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2663)
- [ ] 12. **No silent platform expansion:** Do not automatically launch a public skill store, create a native mobile app, hire specialists, provision paid infrastructure, add payment processing, start healthcare operations or change pricing solely because these features are specified. Each needs explicit implementation approval and existing release gates. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2664)
- [ ] - **T01 LifeOS:** Deduplicate obligations from two authorized sources, preserve both citations, isolate users and correct timezone/permission changes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2668)
- [ ] - **T02 Outcome Autopilot:** Two scheduled cycles execute only once each; revoke and budget exhaustion stop new effects; unknown external outcome does not retry blindly. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2669)
- [ ] - **T03 Problem Radar:** Detect missing evidence/deadline with source, suppress repeat notifications and reject an unconsented monitored folder. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2670)
- [ ] - **T04 Business-in-a-Box:** Two businesses remain isolated; invoice/ledger/onboarding work uses existing four packages; no autonomous payment. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2671)
- [ ] - **T05 Opportunity Engine:** Correctly reject expired, duplicate and scam listings; never invent applicant qualifications or submit without required consent. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2672)
- [ ] - **T06 Work Simulation:** Production hashes remain unchanged in rehearsal; stale inputs invalidate preview; irreversible third-party effects are labeled NOT SIMULATABLE. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2673)
- [ ] - **T07 Proof Passport:** Independent verifier reproduces hashes/checks; redacted export contains no secret; tampering invalidates integrity; UNKNOWN never becomes VERIFIED. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2674)
- [ ] - **T08 Recovery Intelligence:** Crash, reconnect, duplicated events, stale UI and revoked grant produce no duplicate irreversible effects or unauthorized writes. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2675)
- [ ] - **T09 Personal Knowledge Vault:** Cross-user RLS negative tests, opt-in source gating, correction/export/delete, secret fixture exclusion and model-context minimization. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2676)
- [ ] - **T10 Human Expert Escalation:** Unlicensed/unavailable expert fallback; exact consented packet; no data or money sent before explicit approval. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2677)
- [ ] - **T11 Verified Skill Network:** Changed-app quarantine, secret-free sanitized export, scoped replay and cross-user noninterference; no unapproved executable publication. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2678)
- [ ] - **T12 Time Reclaimed Dashboard:** Every visible value recomputes from evidence; missing baseline shows UNKNOWN; retry duplication cannot inflate work or time saved. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2679)
- [ ] - **X01 SkillForge:** User-approved demonstration yields typed, editable, independently verified replay; STOP halts capture and execution. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2680)
- [ ] - **X02 CheckPoint:** Ordinary actions proceed with one scoped grant; changed recipient/amount invalidates a sensitive approval; separate verifier confirms actual effect. [Source](https://github.com/BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan/blob/166328b973ee2533356fcbdc92d946a783fd9a2e/plan.md#L2681)

- [ ] - **X04 Ghost Cursor / Instant Mini-Apps:** Overlay shows real state and never grants authority; generated forms preserve required fields, legal disclosures and original view. Status per law is in the ledger (namespace UX): 20 have an automated browser check (`tests/web/ux_laws_audit.py`, not run on this checkout, so UNVERIFIED) and 14 are source-reviewed only (PARTIAL). Per-route, signed-in, keyboard and screen-reader evidence is not recorded for any law, so none is checked.
